procedure: Add the tax amount and the untaxed amount in the company currency to obtain the total in the company currency.
Add the tax amount and the untaxed amount in the document currency to obtain the total in the document currency.
Divide the total in the document currency by the total in the company currency and take the absolute value; when the total in the company currency is zero, take the rate as zero.
Use this effective rate, and not the currency rate stored on the document, everywhere the distribution converts between the two currencies.
records.formula: total_amount = tax_amount + untaxed_amount ; total_amount_currency = tax_amount_currency + untaxed_amount_currency ; rate = | total_amount_currency ÷ total_amount | , and zero when total_amount is zero

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the four inputs are already rounded and the rate is kept unrounded.
rounding.precision: The company currency for the total in the company currency, the document currency for the total in the document currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier to the four inputs.
rounding.step: The rate is used unrounded in the later divisions, and only the results of those divisions are rounded.

result.name: the two totals and the effective rate
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency, the document currency, and a pure ratio
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the distribution of the instalments.

edge_cases.case: The two currencies are identical.
edge_cases.outcome: The two totals are equal and the effective rate is one.

edge_cases.case: The total in the company currency is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The rate is taken as zero and every branch that divides by it produces zero.

edge_cases.case: The document's stored currency rate differs from the effective rate because of the rounding of the individual lines.
edge_cases.outcome: The effective rate is used, which is what guarantees that the instalments expressed back in the company currency add up exactly to the company-currency total of the document.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice in the company currency with a net total of one thousand and a tax of two hundred and ten.
worked_examples.narrative: Both totals are 1 210.00, so the effective rate is the absolute value of 1 210.00 divided by 1 210.00, that is one.

worked_examples.description: A foreign-currency invoice of 1 210.00 in the document currency worth 1 115.21 in the company currency.
worked_examples.narrative: The effective rate is the absolute value of 1 210.00 divided by 1 115.21, that is 1.0850060527 and more, which differs slightly from the document's stored rate of 1.0850 precisely because the two company-currency figures were rounded line by line.

records.name: The amounts of the last payment term line under the balance rule
records.purpose: Gives the final instalment whatever remains of the two totals, which is what makes the instalments add up exactly to the document total in both currencies with no rounding drift.

operands.name: running residual in the company currency
operands.source: the total in the company currency, less the company amounts of the instalments already produced
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: running residual in the document currency
operands.source: the total in the document currency, less the foreign amounts of the instalments already produced
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: position of the payment term line
operands.source: the stored order of the payment term lines, which is creation order
operands.constraints: the rule applies to the last line only

preconditions.condition: The payment term line being processed is the last one in the stored order.
preconditions.otherwise: The percent branch or the fixed-amount branch applies instead.

procedure: Walk the payment term lines in their stored order, keeping a running residual in each currency, initialised to the two totals.
On reaching the last line, whatever its kind, assign the whole remaining residual in the company currency as the company amount.
Assign the whole remaining residual in the document currency as the foreign amount.
Skip the cash rounding correction, which applies only to lines that are not the last.
Subtract both amounts from the running residual, which then reaches zero.
records.formula: company_amount = residual_amount   and   foreign_amount = residual_amount_currency

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded at this step; the residual is already the difference of rounded quantities.
rounding.precision: The company currency and the document currency respectively.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier to the totals and to the earlier instalments.
rounding.step: No rounding is applied to the last instalment, which is exactly what makes the sum of the instalments equal the total.

result.name: the amounts of the final instalment
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency for the balance, the document currency for the amount in currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as the balance and the amount in currency of the last payment term line.

edge_cases.case: The payment term has a single line.
edge_cases.outcome: That line is the last one, so it takes the whole total, whatever its percentage or fixed amount says.

edge_cases.case: The percentages of the term do not add up to one hundred.
edge_cases.outcome: The last line absorbs the difference, so the instalments still add up to the total.

edge_cases.case: A cash rounding method is configured.
edge_cases.outcome: The earlier instalments were each made a multiple of the coin, so the residual left to the last line is itself a multiple of the coin.

edge_cases.case: The term ends with a fixed-amount line.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance rule still wins: the last line takes the residual and not its fixed amount.

worked_examples.description: A term of thirty and seventy per cent on a total of 1 210.00 in one currency.
worked_examples.narrative: The first instalment took 363.00, so the residual is 847.00 and the last line takes all of it; the two instalments add to exactly 1 210.00.

worked_examples.description: A term of three equal thirds on a total of 100.00.
worked_examples.narrative: Two rounded thirds of 33.33 leave a residual of 33.34, which the last line takes; without the balance rule the three rounded thirds would be 33.33 each and the instalments would fall one hundredth short of the total, leaving the document permanently unbalanced.

records.name: The amounts of a fixed-amount payment term line
records.purpose: Gives an instalment that names a fixed sum rather than a percentage its two amounts, expressed in the document currency and converted to the company currency at the effective rate.

operands.name: fixed value of the payment term line
operands.source: the amount field of the payment term line
operands.constraints: the fixed amount is always read as an amount in the document currency

operands.name: sign parameter
operands.source: plus one when a stored document is inbound and minus one otherwise, or the direction sign when the document is not yet stored
operands.constraints: consumed only by this branch

operands.name: effective rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of the document currency for one unit of the company currency
operands.source: the ratio of the two totals
operands.constraints: zero when the total in the company currency is zero

preconditions.condition: The payment term line is of the fixed-amount kind and is not the last line of the term.
preconditions.otherwise: The percent branch or the balance rule applies.

preconditions.condition: The effective rate is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: Both amounts are taken as zero.

procedure: Round the fixed value to the document currency and multiply it by the sign parameter to obtain the foreign amount.
Divide the fixed value by the effective rate, round the quotient to the company currency and multiply by the sign parameter to obtain the company amount.
Take both amounts as zero when the effective rate is zero.
Apply the cash rounding correction when a cash rounding method is configured, because this line is not the last one.
Subtract both amounts from the running residual.
records.formula: foreign_amount = sign × round( value_amount , document_currency )   and   company_amount = sign × round( value_amount ÷ rate , company_currency ), both zero when the rate is zero

rounding.what: The fixed value in the document currency and its quotient by the effective rate in the company currency.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the first, the company currency for the second.
rounding.step: Each of the two amounts is rounded once, immediately before the sign is applied and before the residual is reduced.

result.name: the amounts of a fixed instalment
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as the amount in currency and the balance of that payment term line.

edge_cases.case: The fixed line is the last line of the term.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance rule wins and the line takes the residual instead of its fixed amount.

edge_cases.case: The effective rate is zero because the company-currency total is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Both amounts are zero.

edge_cases.case: The document is not yet stored.
edge_cases.outcome: The sign parameter is the direction sign, the opposite of the stored case, so the fixed instalment carries the opposite sign; this is the only place where the difference is observable.

edge_cases.case: The fixed amount exceeds the document total.
edge_cases.outcome: The residual left for the last line becomes negative and the last line carries a negative instalment; the instalments still add up to the total.

worked_examples.description: A first instalment of a fixed five hundred on a stored customer invoice in the company currency of 1 210.00.
worked_examples.narrative: The fixed value rounds to 500.00 in the document currency and, divided by an effective rate of one, to 500.00 in the company currency; the residual for the last line becomes 710.00.

worked_examples.description: The same fixed instalment on a foreign-currency invoice whose effective rate is 1.0850.
worked_examples.narrative: The fixed amount is an amount in the document currency, so it stays 500.00 there; divided by 1.0850 it is 460.829493 and more, which rounds to 460.83 in the company currency.

records.name: The amounts of a percent payment term line
records.purpose: Gives an instalment that names a percentage its two amounts, by taking that percentage of each of the two totals independently so that each currency column is right in its own precision.

operands.name: percentage of the payment term line
operands.source: the amount field of the payment term line
operands.constraints: the percentages of a term must add up to one hundred

operands.name: total in the company currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: total in the document currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

preconditions.condition: The payment term line is of the percent kind and is not the last line of the term.
preconditions.otherwise: The fixed-amount branch or the balance rule applies.

procedure: Multiply the total in the company currency by the percentage, divide by one hundred, and round the result to the company currency to obtain the company amount.
Multiply the total in the document currency by the percentage, divide by one hundred, and round the result to the document currency to obtain the foreign amount.
Apply the cash rounding correction when a cash rounding method is configured, because this line is not the last one.
Subtract both amounts from the running residual and record the instalment with its maturity date.
records.formula: company_amount = round( total_amount × value_amount ÷ 100 , company_currency )   and   foreign_amount = round( total_amount_currency × value_amount ÷ 100 , document_currency )

rounding.what: Each of the two products, independently.
rounding.precision: The company currency for the company amount, the document currency for the foreign amount.
rounding.step: After the multiplication by the percentage and the division by one hundred, once per currency, before the residual is reduced.

result.name: the amounts of a percent instalment
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency for the balance, the document currency for the amount in currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as the balance and the amount in currency of that payment term line.

edge_cases.case: The percent line is the last line of the term.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance rule wins and the line takes the residual, which absorbs every rounding difference.

edge_cases.case: The percentage produces a value exactly on a half unit of the last decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: The half is carried away from zero, so thirty per cent of 1 207.35, that is 362.205, becomes 362.21.

edge_cases.case: The two currencies are identical.
edge_cases.outcome: Both roundings give the same figure.

edge_cases.case: The percentage is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Both amounts are zero and the instalment carries nothing, yet the line still exists with its own maturity date unless it merges with another instalment on the same date.

worked_examples.description: A first instalment of thirty per cent on a total of 1 210.00 in one currency.
worked_examples.narrative: One thousand two hundred and ten times thirty divided by one hundred is exactly 363.00 in both currencies.

worked_examples.description: A first instalment of thirty per cent on a total of 1 207.35.
worked_examples.narrative: Thirty per cent of 1 207.35 is 362.205, and the currency carries two decimal places, so the half is carried away from zero and both amounts are 362.21.

records.name: The cash rounding correction of an instalment that is not the last
records.purpose: Makes every instalment before the final one a multiple of the smallest coin, so that a customer paying in cash can settle each instalment exactly and the residual left to the last instalment is itself a multiple of the coin.

operands.name: foreign amount of the instalment
operands.source: the percent branch or the fixed-amount branch
operands.constraints: already rounded to the document currency

operands.name: cash rounding method of the document
operands.source: the cash rounding method field of the document
operands.constraints: the correction is applied only when one is set

operands.name: effective rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of the document currency for one unit of the company currency
operands.source: the ratio of the two totals
operands.constraints: the company amount is zero when the rate is zero

preconditions.condition: A cash rounding method is set on the document.
preconditions.otherwise: No correction is applied and the amounts stand as computed.

preconditions.condition: The instalment is not the last line of the term.
preconditions.otherwise: No correction is applied; the last line takes the residual.

preconditions.condition: The cash rounding difference is not zero at the precision of the document currency.
preconditions.otherwise: No correction is applied.

procedure: Compute the cash rounding difference of the foreign amount in the document currency.
Stop when that difference is zero at the precision of the document currency.
Add the difference to the foreign amount.
Recompute the company amount as the corrected foreign amount divided by the effective rate, rounded to the company currency, taking zero when the rate is zero.
Subtract both corrected amounts from the running residual.
records.formula: difference = cash_rounding_difference( document_currency , foreign_amount ) ; if not is_zero( difference , document_currency ) : foreign_amount = foreign_amount + difference and company_amount = round( foreign_amount ÷ rate , company_currency ), zero when rate is zero

rounding.what: The corrected foreign amount is a multiple of the coin, and the company amount is rounded again after the division.
rounding.precision: The coin of the cash rounding method for the foreign amount, the company currency for the company amount.
rounding.method: The method of the cash rounding method for the coin rounding, half away from zero for the currency rounding.
rounding.step: After the instalment amounts have been computed and before the residual is reduced.

result.name: the corrected instalment amounts
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as the amount in currency and the balance of the payment term line.

edge_cases.case: The instalment is already a multiple of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference is zero, the test on the zero difference stops the correction and the amounts stand.

edge_cases.case: The effective rate is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The company amount is taken as zero.

edge_cases.case: The correction is applied to every instalment but the last.
edge_cases.outcome: The total is assumed to be already cash rounded, so the residual left to the last instalment, being the total less a sum of multiples of the coin, is itself a multiple of the coin.

worked_examples.description: A first instalment of thirty per cent of 1 207.35 with a coin of five hundredths and the nearest method.
worked_examples.narrative: The nearest multiple of five hundredths to 362.21 is 362.20, so the difference is minus 0.01 and the instalment becomes 362.20; the last instalment then takes 1 207.35 less 362.20, that is 845.15, which is itself a multiple of five hundredths.

worked_examples.description: A first instalment of thirty per cent of 1 210.00 with the same coin.
worked_examples.narrative: 363.00 is already a multiple of five hundredths, so the difference is zero and no correction is applied.

records.name: Building the needed terms from the distributed instalments
records.purpose: Turns the instalments the distribution produced into the map of receivable lines the document needs, merging instalments that fall on the same date so that a term with two lines on the same day produces a single receivable line.

operands.name: maturity date of the instalment
operands.source: the due date algorithm applied to the payment term line
operands.constraints: part of the key

operands.name: early payment discount deadline
operands.source: the reference date plus the discount days of the payment term
operands.constraints: part of the key; empty when the term carries no early discount

operands.name: company amount of the instalment
operands.constraints: becomes the balance of the receivable line

operands.name: foreign amount of the instalment
operands.constraints: becomes the amount in currency of the receivable line

operands.name: early discount balance and early discount amount in currency
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
operands.source: the discounted amounts computed by the early payment discount formula
operands.constraints: stored on the receivable line beside the full amounts

preconditions.condition: The document is an invoice and has invoice lines.
preconditions.otherwise: The needed terms are empty and no payment term line is produced.

preconditions.condition: The document has a payment term.
preconditions.otherwise: The single-entry rule for a document without a payment term applies.

procedure: Take each instalment produced by the distribution in turn.
Form its key from the document, the maturity date read as a date, and the early discount deadline.
Form its value from the balance, the amount in currency, the early discount deadline, the early discount balance and the early discount amount in currency.
Add the value to the entry already present under that key when two instalments share a key, so that their balances and their amounts in currency are summed.
records.formula: needed_term( document , maturity_date , discount_deadline ) = ( balance = Σ company amounts , amount_in_currency = Σ foreign amounts , discount_deadline , discount_balance , discount_amount_currency )

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the amounts were rounded by the distribution.
rounding.precision: The company currency for the balance, the document currency for the amount in currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: The merging adds already-rounded amounts.

result.name: the needed terms of the document
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored as such; the generic reconciliation turns each entry into a journal item with display type `payment_term` on the receivable account.

edge_cases.case: Two payment term lines both fall on the same maturity date, for example two lines at zero days.
edge_cases.outcome: The keys are identical, the amounts are added and a single receivable line is produced.

edge_cases.case: The payment term carries no early discount.

procedure: Take the accounting-signed totals of the stored customer invoice: a net amount of 1 000.00 and a tax amount of 210.00, both positive.
Add them to obtain a total of 1 210.00 in each currency, and compute the effective rate as one.
Process the first payment term line, which is a percent line and not the last: thirty per cent of 1 210.00 is 363.00 in both currencies.
Compute its maturity date as the twentieth of January plus zero days.
Reduce the residual to 847.00.
Process the second payment term line, which is the last: it takes the residual of 847.00 in both currencies.
Compute its maturity date as the twentieth of January plus forty-five days.
Produce two journal items on the customer's receivable account, both debits, and set the due date of the document to the later maturity date.

records.name: Selecting the early payment discount computation mode and its default by country
records.purpose: Decides which of the three treatments of the taxable base applies to an early payment discount, which in turn decides whether the invoice itself carries extra journal items and how the write-off at payment time is split.

operands.name: computation mode of the payment term
operands.unit_or_currency: not applicable, a stored selection value
operands.constraints: one of the three stored values `included`, `excluded` and `mixed`

operands.name: country of the company
operands.constraints: decides the default when a payment term is created

preconditions.condition: The payment term carries an early payment discount, that is a percentage and a number of days.
preconditions.otherwise: No mode applies and no discount is computed.

procedure: Read the computation mode of the payment term.
Under the stored value `included`, labelled On early payment, issue the invoice at full value and reduce both the base and the tax at payment time, only if and when the customer pays early.
Under the stored value `excluded`, labelled Never, issue the invoice at full value, discount only the net part and never reduce the tax.

Under the stored value `mixed`, labelled Always (upon invoice), compute the tax on the already-discounted base at invoicing time, whether or not the customer pays early, and carry the extra early payment discount journal items on the invoice.
When a payment term is created and no mode is chosen, take the default of the company's country: `mixed` for Belgium, `excluded` for the Netherlands and `included` for every other country.
records.formula: mode = `included` when the discount reduces the taxable base only on early payment ; `excluded` when the discount never reduces the taxable base ; `mixed` when the tax is computed on the discounted base at invoicing time ; default = `mixed` for Belgium, `excluded` for the Netherlands, `included` elsewhere

rounding.what: Nothing; the mode is a stored selection value.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.unit_or_currency: not applicable, a stored selection value
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the payment term and read by the discounted-amount formulas, by the routine that produces the early payment discount lines and by the write-off at payment time.

edge_cases.case: The mode is `mixed` and the customer pays the full amount late.
edge_cases.outcome: The invoice is settled at its reduced total and the anticipated reduction of tax stands, which is the intent of the mode.

operands.name: cash rounding method of the document
operands.constraints: the correction applies only when one is set

preconditions.condition: A cash rounding method is set on the document.
preconditions.otherwise: No correction is applied.

preconditions.condition: The cash rounding difference is not zero at the precision of the document currency.
preconditions.otherwise: No correction is applied.

procedure: Compute the cash rounding difference of the discounted amount in the document currency.
Stop when the difference is zero at the precision of the document currency.
Add the difference to the discounted amount in the document currency.
Recompute the discount balance as the corrected amount divided by the effective rate, rounded to the company currency, and take zero when the rate is zero.
records.formula: difference = cash_rounding_difference( document_currency , discount_amount_currency ) ; if not is_zero( difference , document_currency ) : discount_amount_currency = discount_amount_currency + difference and discount_balance = round( discount_amount_currency ÷ rate , company_currency ), zero when rate is zero

rounding.what: The discounted amount in the document currency, then the recomputed balance.
rounding.precision: The coin of the cash rounding method, then the company currency.
rounding.method: The method of the cash rounding method for the coin, half away from zero for the currency.
rounding.step: After the discounted amounts have been computed and before they are stored on the receivable line.

result.name: the cash-rounded discounted amounts
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the payment term line.

edge_cases.case: The discounted amount is already a multiple of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference is zero and the amounts stand.

edge_cases.case: The effective rate is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The recomputed balance is zero.

worked_examples.description: A discounted amount of 1 190.00 with a coin of five hundredths, in a single currency.
worked_examples.narrative: 1 190.00 is already a multiple of five hundredths, so nothing changes.

worked_examples.description: A discounted amount of 1 183.32 with the same coin and a rate of one.
worked_examples.narrative: The nearest multiple of five hundredths is 1 183.30, so the difference of minus 0.02 is applied and the balance is recomputed from the corrected amount at a rate of one.

records.name: The early payment discount deadline
records.purpose: Fixes the last date on which the customer may pay the discounted amount, which is stored on every receivable line of the document and drives the eligibility test at payment time.

operands.name: reference date
operands.source: the document date, else the accounting date, else today
operands.constraints: always defined

operands.name: discount days of the payment term
operands.constraints: zero or a positive whole number

preconditions.condition: The payment term carries an early payment discount.
preconditions.otherwise: No deadline is stored and the discount deadline component of the needed term key is empty.

procedure: Take the reference date of the document.
Add the discount days of the payment term, counting whole calendar days.
Store the result on every receivable line as the deadline, and use it as part of the key of the needed terms.
records.formula: discount_date = reference_date + discount_days

rounding.what: Nothing; the arithmetic is on whole calendar days.
rounding.precision: One day.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: early payment discount deadline
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the payment term line, printed on the document beside the discounted amount, and used by the eligibility test.

edge_cases.case: The discount days are zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The deadline is the reference date itself.

edge_cases.case: The document is redated.
edge_cases.outcome: The needed terms are recomputed and the deadline moves with the new reference date.

edge_cases.case: The addition crosses a month boundary.
edge_cases.outcome: The calendar days are counted through.

worked_examples.description: A discount of two per cent within ten days on an invoice dated the twentieth of January of the year 2026.
worked_examples.narrative: Ten days after the twentieth of January is the thirtieth of January, which is the last day on which the discounted amount settles the line.

records.name: Cross-check of the printed amount due against the stored discounted amount
records.purpose: Shows that the formula that prints the amount due and the formula that stores the discounted amount on the receivable line give the same figure in opposite signs, so that a rebuild can test both against one another.

operands.name: gross total, customer-facing
operands.constraints: 1 210.00 in the example

operands.name: tax total, customer-facing
operands.constraints: 210.00 in the example

operands.name: accounting-signed total
operands.source: the distribution totals of the same document seen from the accounting side
operands.constraints: minus 1 210.00 in the example

operands.name: accounting-signed untaxed amount
operands.constraints: minus 1 000.00 in the example

preconditions.condition: Both formulas are applied to the same document with the same discount percentage.
preconditions.otherwise: The cross-check is meaningless.

procedure: Apply the printed amount due formula in the mode that never reduces the tax to the customer-facing totals.
Apply the stored discounted amount formula in the same mode to the accounting-signed totals.
Check that the two results are equal in magnitude and opposite in sign.
Repeat for the mode that reduces the tax on early payment.

rounding.what: Both results, each to its own currency.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: Once per formula; in this example no rounding is needed because every figure falls on a whole hundredth.

result.name: the agreement of the two formulas
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: The first result is printed on the document, the second is stored on the receivable line.

edge_cases.case: The two formulas are compared in the mode that anticipates the discount on the invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: They agree on the reduced totals of that invoice, 1 205.80 gross and 1 000.00 net, giving 1 185.80 on both sides.

worked_examples.description: The mode that never reduces the tax.
worked_examples.narrative: The printed formula gives a discount of 20.00 and an amount due of 1 190.00; the stored formula gives minus 1 210.00 less minus 20.00, that is minus 1 190.00, the same figure in accounting sign.

worked_examples.description: The mode that reduces the tax on early payment.
worked_examples.narrative: The printed formula gives 1 210.00 times 0.98, that is 1 185.80, and the stored formula gives minus 1 210.00 times 0.98, that is minus 1 185.80.

records.name: The early payment discount amount per grouping key in the mode that books it on the invoice
records.purpose: Computes, for each group of product lines that share an account, an analytic distribution and a set of taxes, the amount by which the taxed base is to be reduced when the discount is anticipated at invoicing time.

operands.name: tax-excluded total of the group in the document currency
operands.source: the rounded tax details of the base lines of the group
operands.constraints: positive in the ordinary case

operands.name: tax-excluded total of the group in the company currency
operands.constraints: positive in the ordinary case

operands.name: discount ratio
operands.source: the discount percentage of the payment term divided by one hundred
operands.constraints: between zero and one

operands.name: direction sign
operands.constraints: minus one on a customer invoice

operands.name: grouping key
operands.source: the account, the analytic distribution and the set of taxes actually applied to the base lines
operands.constraints: a group whose totals are empty produces nothing

preconditions.condition: The computation mode of the payment term is `mixed`.
preconditions.otherwise: No early payment discount line is produced on the invoice.

preconditions.condition: The document has at least one product line carrying taxes.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no base to reduce and nothing is produced.

preconditions.condition: The grouping key is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: The group is skipped.

procedure: Take the discount percentage divided by one hundred as the discount ratio and format the percentage with a per-cent sign as the label suffix.
Build one base line per product line, carrying the unit price, the quantity, the discount, the rate and the sign, add the tax details and round them.

Dispatch every tax that cannot be discounted into a separate base line, a tax being non-discountable when its amount kind is a fixed amount or a code-driven amount, so that the discount never touches it.
Aggregate the base lines by the grouping key made of the account, the analytic distribution and the set of taxes actually applied.

For each non-empty grouping key, multiply the direction sign, the tax-excluded total of the group and the discount ratio, and round the product to the document currency for the amount in currency and to the company currency for the balance.
records.formula: epd_amount_currency = round( sign × total_excluded_currency of the group × p , document_currency )   and   epd_balance = round( sign × total_excluded of the group × p , company_currency )

rounding.what: The discount amount of each grouping key, in each currency.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance.
rounding.step: Once per currency, after the multiplication by the sign and by the discount ratio, and before the amount is distributed over the product lines of the group.

result.name: the early payment discount amount of a grouping key
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored directly; it is split into a base-shift entry and a counterpart entry, which become journal items with display type `epd`.

edge_cases.case: A tax of the group has a fixed amount or a code-driven amount.
edge_cases.outcome: It is dispatched into a separate base line so that the discount never reduces it.

edge_cases.case: Two product lines share the account, the analytic distribution and the taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: They fall in one group and produce a single pair of early payment discount lines.

edge_cases.case: The group's tax-excluded total is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The discount amount is zero and the pair of entries cancels, so the aggregation drops the key.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice with a single product line of one thousand at twenty-one per cent and a discount of two per cent.
worked_examples.narrative: Minus one times 1 000.00 times 0.02 is minus 20.00, the amount by which the taxed base is to be shifted; the base-shift entry carries its negation, plus 20.00, and the counterpart entry carries minus 20.00.

records.name: The base-shift and counterpart entries of the anticipated discount and their distribution over the product lines
records.purpose: Splits the anticipated discount of each group into two journal items that cancel in the net total, one removing the discounted part from the taxed base and one putting it back untaxed, and spreads both across the individual product lines so that the rounded shares still add up.

operands.name: discount amount of the group in the document currency
operands.source: the early payment discount amount of the grouping key
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: discount balance of the group
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: raw tax-excluded amount of each base line
operands.source: the unrounded tax details of the line
operands.constraints: used as the weight of the distribution

operands.name: label suffix
operands.source: the discount percentage formatted with a per-cent sign
operands.constraints: both entries are labelled “Early Payment Discount” followed by that suffix in brackets

preconditions.condition: The discount amount of the group is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The two entries cancel and the aggregation drops the key.

preconditions.condition: The document has product lines in the group.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to distribute the amount over.

procedure: Produce a base-shift entry, keyed by the document, the grouping key and the display type `epd`, which will carry the negative of the discount so that the taxed base is reduced.

Produce a counterpart entry, keyed by the document, the account, the analytic distribution and the display type `epd`, carrying no taxes, which will carry the positive discount so that the net total is unchanged.
Label both entries “Early Payment Discount” followed by the percentage in brackets.
Distribute each of the two totals across the individual product lines of the group, using the raw tax-excluded amount of each base line as the weight.
Round each share to the precision of the currency and allocate the remaining units one by one to the largest weights, by the smooth delta-distribution rule of the tax engine.
Subtract each share from the base-shift entry and add it to the counterpart entry, in each of the two currencies.
Hand the resulting per-product-line maps to the generic reconciliation as the early discount needed values.
records.formula: base_shift_entry.amount_currency −= share of epd_amount_currency ; counterpart_entry.amount_currency += share of epd_amount_currency ; base_shift_entry.balance −= share of epd_balance ; counterpart_entry.balance += share of epd_balance

rounding.what: Each line's share of the group discount.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the amounts in currency, the company currency for the balances.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, with the remaining units allocated one by one to the largest weights so that the shares add up to the group total.
rounding.step: After the weights have been taken from the raw tax-excluded amounts and before the shares are written into the two entries.

result.name: the pair of early payment discount lines per grouping key
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as journal items with display type `epd`; the base-shift line carries the taxes of the product lines and the counterpart line carries none.

edge_cases.case: The base-shift line is itself a base line for the tax engine.
edge_cases.outcome: The tax lines the engine produces are computed on the reduced base, which is the whole point of the mode.

edge_cases.case: The base-shift and the counterpart are added together.
edge_cases.outcome: They cancel, so the net total of the invoice is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The group holds several product lines and the shares do not divide evenly.
edge_cases.outcome: The remaining units of the last decimal place are allocated to the largest weights, so the shares still add up to the group total.

worked_examples.description: A single product line of one thousand at twenty-one per cent with a discount of two per cent, on a customer invoice.
worked_examples.narrative: The base-shift line is a debit of 20.00 on the income account carrying the taxes of the product line, so the tax engine computes twenty-one per cent on 1 000.00 less 20.00, that is 205.80; the counterpart line is a credit of 20.00 on the same account with no taxes, so the net total stays 1 000.00.

worked_examples.description: Two product lines of the same group, of 600.00 and 400.00 tax-excluded, with a group discount of minus 20.00.
worked_examples.narrative: The shares are proportional to the raw tax-excluded amounts, giving minus 12.00 and minus 8.00, which add back to the group total of minus 20.00.

records.name: Worked example of the early payment discount in the mode that reduces the tax on early payment
records.purpose: Carries one invoice and its early settlement from end to end under the mode that leaves the invoice at full value and reduces both base and tax when the customer pays early.

operands.name: product line
operands.constraints: quantity one, unit price one thousand, no line discount

operands.name: tax
operands.constraints: twenty-one per cent, not included in the price and not a fixed amount

operands.name: payment term
operands.constraints: a single line of one hundred per cent at thirty days, with a discount of two per cent within ten days

operands.name: document date
operands.constraints: the twentieth of January of the year 2026

preconditions.condition: The computation mode of the payment term is `included`.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two worked examples applies.

preconditions.condition: The company currency equals the document currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The two currency columns diverge.

procedure: Issue the invoice at full value: a credit of 1 000.00 on the income account, a credit of 210.00 of tax and a debit of 1 210.00 on the receivable account.
Store on the receivable line the deadline of the thirtieth of January, a discounted amount in currency of 1 210.00 times 0.98 and the same discount balance.
When the customer pays 1 185.80 on the twenty-fifth of January, write off the difference of 24.20 against both the base and the tax.
Book a debit of 20.00 on the cash discount write-off loss account and a debit of 4.20 on the tax account.
Reconcile the receivable of 1 210.00 against the payment of 1 185.80 plus the write-off of 24.20.
When the customer instead pays 1 210.00 on the nineteenth of February, after the deadline, grant nothing and settle the invoice at full value.
records.formula: discount_amount_currency = round( 1210.00 × ( 1 − 0.02 ) ) = 1185.80 ; write-off = 1210.00 − 1185.80 = 24.20 = 20.00 on the base + 4.20 on the tax ; tax declared = 210.00 − 4.20 = 205.80 on a base of 980.00

rounding.what: The discounted amount and each write-off line.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: The discounted amount is rounded when the receivable line is written; the write-off lines are rounded when the payment counterpart is prepared.

result.name: the invoice, its stored discount and its settlement
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency, which is also the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: The invoice lines and the receivable line are stored on the document; the write-off lines are stored on the payment's own entry.

edge_cases.case: The customer pays after the deadline.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing special happens and the discount is simply not granted.

edge_cases.case: The tax return is compared before and after.
edge_cases.outcome: The tax actually declared becomes 205.80 on a base of 980.00 instead of 210.00 on a base of 1 000.00.

worked_examples.description: The invoice and an early payment of the discounted amount.
worked_examples.narrative: The invoice is issued at 1 210.00 and the receivable line remembers that 1 185.80 would settle it before the thirtieth of January; the payment of 1 185.80 leaves 24.20, which is written off as 20.00 of base on the cash discount write-off loss account and 4.20 of tax on the tax account, so the receivable clears exactly and the tax return shows 205.80 on a base of 980.00.

worked_examples.description: The same invoice paid in full after the deadline.
worked_examples.narrative: The payment arrives after the thirtieth of January, so the eligibility test fails, no counterpart line is prepared and the invoice is settled at its full value.

records.name: Worked example of the early payment discount in the mode that never reduces the tax
records.purpose: Carries the same invoice and its early settlement under the mode where only the net part is discounted and the tax stays fully owed.

operands.name: product line
operands.constraints: quantity one, unit price one thousand, no line discount

operands.name: tax
operands.constraints: twenty-one per cent

operands.name: payment term
operands.constraints: one hundred per cent at thirty days, discount of two per cent within ten days

preconditions.condition: The computation mode of the payment term is `excluded`.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two worked examples applies.

procedure: Issue the invoice at full value, exactly as in the mode that reduces the tax on early payment.
Store on the receivable line the deadline of the thirtieth of January and a discounted amount computed as the gross total less two per cent of the net total.
When the customer pays 1 190.00 on the twenty-fifth of January, write off the difference of 20.00 entirely against the net account.
Leave the tax untouched, so that the tax return still shows 210.00 on a base of 1 000.00.
records.formula: discount_amount_currency = round( 1210.00 − 1000.00 × 0.02 ) = round( 1210.00 − 20.00 ) = 1190.00 ; write-off = 1210.00 − 1190.00 = 20.00, all of it on the net account

rounding.what: The discounted amount and the single write-off line.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: The discounted amount when the receivable line is written, the write-off when the payment counterpart is prepared.

result.name: the invoice, its stored discount and its settlement
result.stored_or_displayed: The invoice lines on the document, the single write-off line on the payment's entry.

edge_cases.case: The tax return is compared with the mode that reduces the tax.
edge_cases.outcome: It stays at 210.00 on a base of 1 000.00, whereas the other mode reduces it to 205.80 on 980.00.

edge_cases.case: The customer pays the full 1 210.00.
edge_cases.outcome: No write-off is prepared and the invoice is settled at full value.

worked_examples.description: The invoice and an early payment of the discounted amount.
worked_examples.narrative: The invoice is issued at 1 210.00 and the receivable line remembers that 1 190.00 would settle it before the thirtieth of January; the payment of 1 190.00 leaves 20.00, written off entirely on the cash discount write-off loss account, and no tax line is produced, so the tax stays fully declared.

records.name: Worked example of the early payment discount in the mode that anticipates it on the invoice
records.purpose: Carries the same invoice under the mode where the tax is computed on the already-discounted base at invoicing time, so that the invoice itself carries two extra journal items.

operands.name: product line
operands.constraints: quantity one, unit price one thousand, no line discount

operands.name: tax
operands.constraints: twenty-one per cent

operands.name: payment term
operands.constraints: one hundred per cent at thirty days, discount of two per cent within ten days

operands.name: income account
operands.constraints: both early payment discount lines are booked on it

preconditions.condition: The computation mode of the payment term is `mixed`.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two worked examples applies.

preconditions.condition: The product line carries a tax.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no base to reduce.

procedure: Apply the anticipated discount routine to the single product line and its single grouping key, giving a discount amount of minus 20.00.

Produce the base-shift line on the income account, carrying the taxes of the product line, with an accounting amount of plus 20.00, that is a debit of 20.00 reducing the credited revenue that is taxed.
Produce the counterpart line on the same account, with no taxes, with an accounting amount of minus 20.00, that is a credit of 20.00.
Let the tax engine compute twenty-one per cent on a base of 1 000.00 less 20.00, that is 980.00, giving a tax of 205.80.
Build the single receivable line of 1 205.80 and store on it the deadline of the thirtieth of January and a discounted amount of the reduced gross total less two per cent of the net total.
When the customer pays 1 185.80 on the twenty-fifth of January, write off the remaining 20.00 against the net account only, because the tax was already reduced on the invoice.

rounding.what: The discount amount of the grouping key, the tax on the reduced base and the stored discounted amount.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: The discount amount before it is split into the two lines, the tax when the engine computes it on the reduced base, and the discounted amount when the receivable line is written.

result.name: the invoice with its two anticipated discount lines and its settlement
result.stored_or_displayed: Five journal items on the invoice, and one write-off line on the payment's entry.

edge_cases.case: The customer pays the full 1 205.80 late.
edge_cases.outcome: The invoice is simply settled and the anticipated reduction of tax stands, which is the intent of the mode.

edge_cases.case: The two early payment discount lines are added together.
edge_cases.outcome: They cancel, so the net total of the invoice is unchanged at 1 000.00.

edge_cases.case: The invoice is reversed.
edge_cases.outcome: The payment term is kept on the credit note rather than cleared, so that the anticipated reduction is reversed with it.

worked_examples.description: The invoice with its five journal items.
worked_examples.narrative: The two early payment discount lines of 20.00 cancel in the net total but the base-shift line carries the taxes, so the tax is computed on 980.00 and comes to 205.80; the receivable line is 1 205.80 and remembers that 1 185.80 would settle it before the thirtieth of January.

worked_examples.description: The early payment of the discounted amount.
worked_examples.narrative: The remaining 20.00 is written off on the cash discount write-off loss account only; no tax line is produced because the tax was already reduced when the invoice was issued.

records.name: Side-by-side comparison of the three early payment discount modes
records.purpose: Sets the three modes against one another on the same invoice, so that a rebuild can check every figure that differs between them in one place.

operands.name: net total before any discount
operands.source: the single product line of the example
operands.constraints: one thousand

operands.name: tax rate
operands.constraints: twenty-one per cent

operands.name: discount percentage
operands.constraints: two per cent within ten days

preconditions.condition: The three modes are compared on the same invoice with the same discount.
preconditions.otherwise: The comparison is meaningless.

procedure: Compute the invoice totals under each mode.
Count the extra journal items each mode puts on the invoice.
Compute the discounted amount each mode stores on the receivable line.
Compute the discount actually granted when the customer pays early.
Split the write-off at payment time into its net and its tax parts.
records.formula: mode `included` : net 1000.00, tax 210.00, gross 1210.00, stored discounted amount 1185.80, discount granted 24.20, write-off 20.00 net + 4.20 tax ; mode `excluded` : net 1000.00, tax 210.00, gross 1210.00, stored discounted amount 1190.00, discount granted 20.00, write-off 20.00 net ; mode `mixed` : net 1000.00, tax 205.80, gross 1205.80, two `epd` lines of 20.00, stored discounted amount 1185.80, discount granted 20.00, write-off 20.00 net

rounding.what: Every figure of the comparison.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: Each figure is rounded by the formula that produces it; no further rounding is applied to the comparison.

result.name: the comparison of the three modes
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as a comparison; each individual figure is stored by the mode that produces it.

edge_cases.case: The net total is compared across the three modes.
edge_cases.outcome: It is 1 000.00 in all three, because the two anticipated discount lines cancel.

edge_cases.case: The discount actually granted is compared.
edge_cases.outcome: It is 24.20 in the mode that reduces the tax on early payment and 20.00 in the other two.

worked_examples.description: The three modes on the invoice of one thousand net at twenty-one per cent with a discount of two per cent.
worked_examples.narrative: Only the mode that anticipates the discount changes the invoice itself, reducing the tax to 205.80 and adding two lines of 20.00 that cancel; only the mode that reduces the tax on early payment grants more than the net discount, 24.20 rather than 20.00, and only it splits the write-off across the base and the tax.

records.name: The eligibility test for the early payment discount write-off
records.purpose: Decides whether a payment settling a receivable line still earns the discount, which is what makes the platform prepare the counterpart lines that clear the full receivable.

operands.name: payment currency
operands.constraints: must equal the document currency

operands.name: document type
operands.constraints: must be a customer invoice, a sales receipt, a vendor bill or a purchase receipt

operands.name: early discount of the payment term
operands.source: the payment term of the document
operands.constraints: must be present

operands.name: reference date of the payment
operands.constraints: must be on or before the deadline stored on the first payment term line, unless there is no reference date or the document has no document date

operands.name: reconciliation state of the payment term lines
operands.source: the payment term lines of the document
operands.constraints: none of them may already be reconciled

preconditions.condition: Every one of the five conditions holds.
preconditions.otherwise: No counterpart is prepared and the payment settles only what it covers, leaving a residual on the receivable line.

procedure: Check that the payment currency equals the document currency.
Check that the document type is one of customer invoice, sales receipt, vendor bill or purchase receipt.
Check that the payment term carries an early discount.
Check that either there is no reference date, or the document has no document date, or the reference date is on or before the deadline stored on the first payment term line.
Check that none of the payment term lines is already reconciled.
Report eligibility only when all five checks pass.
records.formula: eligible = ( payment currency = document currency ) and ( document type ∈ { customer invoice, sales receipt, vendor bill, purchase receipt } ) and ( the payment term carries an early discount ) and ( no reference date, or no document date, or reference date ≤ deadline of the first payment term line ) and ( no payment term line is reconciled )

rounding.what: Nothing; the test compares dates, currencies and flags.
rounding.precision: One day for the date comparison.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: eligibility for the discount
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; it decides whether the counterpart lines are prepared and whether the portal shows an instalment of the early-discount kind.

edge_cases.case: The payment is made in a currency other than the document currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The document is not eligible and no write-off is prepared.

edge_cases.case: The reference date falls after the deadline.
edge_cases.outcome: The document is not eligible, unless there is no reference date at all or the document has no document date.

edge_cases.case: One payment term line is already reconciled.
edge_cases.outcome: The document is not eligible, so a partly settled document cannot pick up the discount afterwards.

edge_cases.case: The deadline is read from the first payment term line.
edge_cases.outcome: A term with several instalments is tested against the deadline of its first line only.

worked_examples.description: A payment of the discounted amount five days after an invoice dated the twentieth of January with a deadline of the thirtieth of January.
worked_examples.narrative: All five conditions hold, so the counterpart lines are prepared and the full receivable of 1 210.00 is cleared by the payment of 1 185.80 plus the write-off of 24.20.

worked_examples.description: A payment made on the nineteenth of February against the same invoice.
worked_examples.narrative: The reference date is after the deadline, so no counterpart is prepared and the invoice is settled at full value.

records.name: Preparing the discounted base lines, the inverse repartition index and the write-off account
records.purpose: Builds the inputs of the write-off: the base lines as they would have been at the discounted price, the tax amounts indexed so that the write-off books on the refund side of each tax, and the account the write-off lands on.

operands.name: tax amounts of the document
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance
operands.source: the tax lines of the document
operands.constraints: indexed by the inverse repartition line, that is the repartition line at the same position in the repartition list of the opposite document kind

operands.name: unit price of each product line
operands.source: the product lines of the document
operands.constraints: multiplied by one hundred less the discount percentage, divided by one hundred

operands.name: discount percentage
operands.constraints: nothing is produced when it is zero

operands.name: write-off account
operands.source: the company's cash discount write-off loss account for an inbound document, the cash discount write-off gain account for an outbound document
operands.constraints: must be configured for the write-off to be booked

operands.name: analytic distribution of the write-off
operands.source: the base line's own distribution when it has one, otherwise the distribution resolved from the distribution models by the account prefix, the company, the commercial entity and the partner's tags
operands.constraints: part of the grouping key

preconditions.condition: The discount percentage is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is produced.

preconditions.condition: The write-off account is configured on the company.
preconditions.otherwise: The write-off cannot be booked.

procedure: Stop when the discount percentage is zero.

Collect the current tax amounts of the document and index them by the inverse repartition line, that is the repartition line at the same position in the repartition list of the opposite document kind, so that the write-off books on the refund side of each tax.
Build one base line per product line, marked as a refund, with every fixed-amount tax removed and the unit price multiplied by one hundred less the discount percentage and divided by one hundred.
Add the tax details to those base lines, round them, and add the accounting data.
Choose the write-off account: the company's cash discount write-off loss account for an inbound document, the cash discount write-off gain account for an outbound document.
Resolve the analytic distribution of the write-off account from the distribution models, keyed by the account prefix, the company, the commercial entity and the partner's tags.
records.formula: discounted_unit_price = unit_price × ( 100 − discount_percentage ) ÷ 100 ; write-off account = cash discount write-off loss account when the document is inbound, cash discount write-off gain account when it is outbound

rounding.what: The tax details of the discounted base lines.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the amounts in currency, the company currency for the balances.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied by the tax engine.
rounding.step: After the discounted unit prices have been set and before the deltas are taken.

result.name: the discounted base lines, the inverse tax index and the write-off account
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; consumed by the delta computations that produce the write-off lines on the payment's own entry.

edge_cases.case: A tax of a product line has a fixed amount.
edge_cases.outcome: It is removed from the discounted base line, so the discount never touches it.

edge_cases.case: The base line already carries an analytic distribution.
edge_cases.outcome: That distribution is used for the write-off rather than the one resolved from the models.

edge_cases.case: The document is a vendor bill.
edge_cases.outcome: The write-off lands on the cash discount write-off gain account, because the company takes the discount rather than granting it.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice with a single product line of one thousand at twenty-one per cent and a discount of two per cent.

expected_outputs.write-off account: the company's cash discount write-off loss account

worked_examples.narrative: The unit price is multiplied by ninety-eight hundredths, giving a discounted base of 980.00 and a discounted tax of 205.80; the document is inbound, so the write-off lands on the cash discount write-off loss account.

records.name: The undiscounted remainder of a payment term line to be cleared by the write-off
records.purpose: States how much of a receivable line the write-off has to absorb, namely the difference between its full amount and the discounted amount stored on it, in each of the two currencies.

operands.name: amount in currency of the payment term line
operands.constraints: the full instalment amount

operands.name: discount amount in currency of the payment term line
operands.constraints: the discounted amount stored beside the full one

operands.name: balance of the payment term line
operands.constraints: the full instalment balance

operands.name: discount balance of the payment term line
operands.constraints: the discounted balance stored beside the full one

preconditions.condition: The document is eligible for the discount.
preconditions.otherwise: No write-off is prepared and no remainder is computed.

preconditions.condition: The receivable line carries the stored discounted amounts.
preconditions.otherwise: The remainder equals the full amount, so the write-off would have to absorb the whole line.

procedure: Subtract the discount amount in currency from the amount in currency of the payment term line to obtain the remainder in the document currency.
Subtract the discount balance from the balance of the payment term line to obtain the remainder in the company currency.
Carry both remainders into the final rounding fix, which forces the produced write-off lines to add up to them exactly.
records.formula: term_amount_currency = payment_term_line.amount_currency − payment_term_line.discount_amount_currency   and   term_balance = payment_term_line.balance − payment_term_line.discount_balance

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; both operands are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The document currency and the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied when the two stored amounts were written.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the remainder the write-off must absorb
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; it is the target that the final rounding fix of the write-off must reach exactly.

edge_cases.case: The discounted amount equals the full amount because the discount percentage is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The remainder is zero and nothing is produced.

edge_cases.case: The document is a customer credit note.
edge_cases.outcome: Both amounts are negative and the remainder is negative too.

worked_examples.description: The receivable line of an invoice of 1 210.00 whose stored discounted amount is 1 185.80.
worked_examples.narrative: The write-off must absorb 24.20, which under the mode that reduces the tax on early payment is split into 20.00 of base and 4.20 of tax.

worked_examples.description: The receivable line of the same invoice under the mode that never reduces the tax, whose stored discounted amount is 1 190.00.
worked_examples.narrative: The write-off must absorb 20.00, all of it on the net account.

records.name: The base delta of the write-off per grouping key
records.purpose: Measures, for each group of lines, how far the discounted tax-excluded amount falls below what the invoice actually booked, which is the part of the discount that lands on the write-off account.

operands.name: discounted tax-excluded total of the base line in the document currency
operands.source: the tax details of the discounted base lines
operands.constraints: multiplied by the direction sign

operands.name: amount in currency booked by the invoice line
operands.source: the product line of the document
operands.constraints: the accounting amount already stored

operands.name: discounted tax-excluded total of the base line in the company currency
operands.constraints: multiplied by the direction sign

operands.name: balance booked by the invoice line
operands.source: the product line of the document
operands.constraints: the accounting balance already stored

operands.name: grouping key of the write-off
operands.source: the partner, the currency, the write-off account and the analytic distribution; under the mode that reduces the tax on early payment it also carries the taxes and the tax grids
operands.constraints: the deltas are accumulated per key

preconditions.condition: The discounted base lines have been built and their tax details rounded.
preconditions.otherwise: The delta cannot be measured.

procedure: For each base line, multiply the discounted tax-excluded total in the document currency by the direction sign and subtract the amount in currency the invoice line booked, then round to the document currency.
Do the same in the company currency against the balance the invoice line booked, rounding to the company currency.
Accumulate both deltas under the grouping key made of the partner, the currency, the write-off account and the analytic distribution.
Add the taxes and the tax grids to the grouping key when the computation mode is the one that reduces the tax on early payment, so that the write-off itself is taxed and reported.
records.formula: amount_currency = round( direction_sign × discounted_total_excluded_currency − invoice_line.amount_currency , document_currency )   and   balance = round( direction_sign × discounted_total_excluded − invoice_line.balance , company_currency )

rounding.what: Each delta, per base line, before it is accumulated.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance.
rounding.step: Once per base line and per currency, after the subtraction and before the accumulation under the grouping key.

result.name: the accumulated base delta per grouping key
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored as such; each accumulated delta becomes a write-off base line on the payment's own entry.

edge_cases.case: The computation mode is the one that reduces the tax on early payment.
edge_cases.outcome: The grouping key also carries the taxes and the tax grids, so the write-off base line is taxed and appears on the tax return with the refund sign.

edge_cases.case: The computation mode never reduces the tax, or anticipates the discount on the invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: The grouping key carries no taxes and the write-off base line is untaxed.

edge_cases.case: Several product lines share the partner, the currency, the write-off account and the analytic distribution.
edge_cases.outcome: Their deltas accumulate into a single write-off base line.

worked_examples.description: A single product line of one thousand on a customer invoice, discounted by two per cent.
worked_examples.narrative: Minus one times 980.00 is minus 980.00, and subtracting the minus 1 000.00 the invoice booked gives a delta of plus 20.00, which is the debit that lands on the cash discount write-off loss account.

records.name: The share of the document that one payment term line represents
records.purpose: Scales the write-off to the part of the document this payment actually settles, so that a document paid in instalments earns the discount instalment by instalment rather than all at once.

operands.name: residual in currency of the payment term line
operands.constraints: what is still outstanding on that line

operands.name: gross total of the document
operands.constraints: customer-facing and positive

preconditions.condition: The gross total of the document is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The share cannot be formed and no write-off is scaled.

procedure: Divide the residual in currency of the payment term line by the gross total of the document.
Take the absolute value of the quotient.
Multiply every write-off base delta and every write-off tax delta by that share.
records.formula: percentage_paid = | payment_term_line.amount_residual_currency ÷ document.amount_total |

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the share is kept unrounded and only the products are rounded.
rounding.precision: Not applicable to the share itself.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied to each product.
rounding.step: The share is applied to each delta and the product is rounded once, per line and per currency.

result.name: the share of the document settled by this payment term line
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored; it multiplies the amounts of every write-off line prepared for this payment term line.

edge_cases.case: The document has a single instalment covering the whole total.
edge_cases.outcome: The share is one and the write-off carries the full deltas.

edge_cases.case: The document has two instalments of thirty and seventy per cent.
edge_cases.outcome: Settling the first gives a share of thirty hundredths and the write-off carries thirty per cent of the deltas.

edge_cases.case: The payment term line is partly settled already.
edge_cases.outcome: Its residual is smaller than its amount, so the share is smaller and the write-off is smaller in proportion; the eligibility test, however, refuses a document any of whose payment term lines is already reconciled.

worked_examples.description: A single instalment of 1 210.00 fully outstanding on a document whose gross total is 1 210.00.
worked_examples.narrative: The instalment covers the whole document, so the share is one and the deltas are carried in full.

worked_examples.description: A first instalment of 363.00 on a document whose gross total is 1 210.00.
worked_examples.narrative: Three hundred and sixty-three divided by 1 210.00 is exactly thirty hundredths, so the write-off prepared for this instalment carries thirty per cent of each delta.

records.name: The tax write-off lines of the mode that reduces the tax on early payment
records.purpose: Produces the journal items that reverse the part of the tax the customer no longer owes, which exist only in the mode where the discount reduces the taxable base at payment time.

operands.name: tax amount of the discounted base lines
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance
operands.source: the tax lines prepared from the discounted base lines
operands.constraints: one per tax repartition

operands.name: tax amount the invoice booked for the inverse repartition line
operands.source: the tax index built at the start of the write-off
operands.constraints: subtracted from the discounted tax amount to give the delta

operands.name: share of the document settled by this payment term line
operands.constraints: multiplies each delta

operands.name: tax name
operands.source: the tax the repartition belongs to
operands.constraints: appears in the label of the produced line

preconditions.condition: The computation mode is `included`.
preconditions.otherwise: No tax write-off line is produced; the other two modes write off the net part only.

preconditions.condition: The product lines carry taxes.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no tax to reverse.

procedure: Prepare the tax lines from the discounted base lines.
For each of them, subtract the tax amount the invoice actually booked for the inverse repartition line, giving the tax delta in each currency.
Multiply each delta by the share of the document this payment term line represents and round the product to the currency it belongs to.
Produce one write-off tax line per delta, labelled “Early Payment Discount” followed by the tax name in brackets, on that tax's account and carrying that tax's grids with the refund sign.
records.formula: amount_currency = round( tax_delta_amount_currency × percentage_paid , document_currency )   and   balance = round( tax_delta_balance × percentage_paid , company_currency )

rounding.what: Each scaled tax delta.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance.
rounding.step: Once per line and per currency, after the multiplication by the share and before the final rounding fix.

result.name: the write-off tax lines
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the payment's own entry, on the account of the tax concerned.

edge_cases.case: The computation mode never reduces the tax.
edge_cases.outcome: No tax write-off line is produced and the tax stays fully declared.

edge_cases.case: The computation mode anticipates the discount on the invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: No tax write-off line is produced, because the tax was already reduced when the invoice was issued.

edge_cases.case: The document carries several taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: One write-off tax line is produced per affected repartition, each labelled with its own tax name.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice of one thousand net at twenty-one per cent, discounted by two per cent, settled in full.
worked_examples.narrative: The tax on the discounted base of 980.00 is 205.80 against the 210.00 the invoice booked, so the delta is 4.20; the share is one, so the write-off tax line carries 4.20 as a debit on the tax account, and the tax return shows a reduction of 4.20 on a base reduction of 20.00.

records.name: The base write-off lines scaled by the share of the document
records.purpose: Produces the journal items that carry the net part of the discount onto the write-off account, scaled to the part of the document the payment settles.

operands.name: accumulated base delta of the grouping key in the document currency
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: accumulated base delta of the grouping key in the company currency
operands.constraints: signed

operands.name: share of the document settled by this payment term line
operands.constraints: multiplies each delta

preconditions.condition: At least one accumulated base delta is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: No write-off base line is produced.

procedure: Take each accumulated base delta in turn.
Multiply the delta in the document currency by the share and round the product to the document currency.
Multiply the delta in the company currency by the share and round the product to the company currency.

Produce one write-off base line per grouping key, labelled “Early Payment Discount”, on the write-off account, with the analytic distribution of the grouping key, and with the taxes and the tax grids of the key when the mode is the one that reduces the tax on early payment.
records.formula: amount_currency = round( base_delta_amount_currency × percentage_paid , document_currency )   and   balance = round( base_delta_balance × percentage_paid , company_currency )

rounding.what: Each scaled base delta.
rounding.precision: The document currency for the amount in currency, the company currency for the balance.
rounding.step: Once per line and per currency, after the multiplication by the share and before the final rounding fix.

result.name: the write-off base lines
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the payment's own entry, on the company's cash discount write-off loss or gain account.

edge_cases.case: The share is one.
edge_cases.outcome: The write-off base line carries the whole delta.

edge_cases.case: Several grouping keys exist.
edge_cases.outcome: One write-off base line is produced per key, each with its own analytic distribution.

edge_cases.case: The mode reduces the tax on early payment.
edge_cases.outcome: The write-off base line carries the taxes and the tax grids of the original base line, so the base reduction is reported on the tax return.

worked_examples.description: A single grouping key with a delta of 20.00, settled in full.

expected_outputs.label: Early Payment Discount
expected_outputs.side: debit on the cash discount write-off loss account

worked_examples.narrative: The delta is carried in full, so the write-off base line is a debit of 20.00 on the cash discount write-off loss account.

worked_examples.description: The same key on a document settled by a first instalment of thirty per cent.
worked_examples.narrative: Thirty per cent of the delta is 6.00, so the write-off prepared for the first instalment is a debit of 6.00.

records.name: The final rounding fix that makes the write-off clear the receivable exactly
records.purpose: Adds the last remaining difference to one write-off line so that the payment plus the write-off clears the receivable line to the last unit of the currency, whatever rounding happened in the individual lines.

operands.name: remainder of the payment term line in the document currency
operands.source: the difference between the full and the discounted amount in currency of the receivable line
operands.constraints: the target the write-off must reach

operands.name: remainder of the payment term line in the company currency
operands.source: the difference between the full and the discounted balance
operands.constraints: the target in the second currency

operands.name: sum of the write-off base line amounts
operands.constraints: already rounded

operands.name: sum of the write-off tax line amounts
operands.source: the produced tax write-off lines, which exist only in the mode that reduces the tax on early payment
operands.constraints: already rounded

preconditions.condition: At least one write-off base line exists.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no line to carry the correction.

procedure: Subtract the sum of the write-off base line amounts and the sum of the write-off tax line amounts from the remainder, in the document currency.
Do the same in the company currency.
Add both differences to the write-off base line with the largest amount in currency.
records.formula: delta_amount_currency = term_amount_currency − Σ base line amounts − Σ tax line amounts   and   delta_balance = term_balance − Σ base line balances − Σ tax line balances, both added to the base line with the largest amount in currency

rounding.what: Nothing further; the correction is exactly the difference between already-rounded quantities.
rounding.precision: The document currency and the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier to each line.
rounding.step: After every write-off line has been produced and rounded, as the last step before the counterpart is written.

result.name: the corrected write-off lines
