result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the payment's own entry; after the correction the payment plus the write-off clears the receivable line exactly.

edge_cases.case: The produced lines already add up to the remainder.
edge_cases.outcome: Both differences are zero and no correction is applied.

edge_cases.case: Several base lines exist.
edge_cases.outcome: The correction lands on the one with the largest amount in currency.

edge_cases.case: The rounding of the individual lines left a difference of one unit of the last decimal place.
edge_cases.outcome: That unit is added to the largest base line, so the receivable clears to the last unit.

worked_examples.description: A write-off of 20.00 of base and 4.20 of tax against a remainder of 24.20.
worked_examples.narrative: The produced lines already add to 24.20, so no correction is applied, and the payment of 1 185.80 plus the write-off of 24.20 clears the receivable debit of 1 210.00 exactly.

worked_examples.description: A write-off whose rounded lines add to 24.19 against a remainder of 24.20.
worked_examples.narrative: The lines fall one hundredth short, so 0.01 is added to the base line with the largest amount in currency and the receivable clears exactly.

records.name: Selecting the discount allocation account
records.purpose: Decides whether the discounted part of the product lines is moved out of the revenue account into a separate account, and which account that is, so that gross revenue and discounts granted can be read separately.

operands.name: separate account for expense discount of the company
operands.source: the company, under the identifier `account_discount_expense_allocation_id`, whose full name is the separate account for expense discount
operands.constraints: used on a sale document

operands.name: separate account for income discount of the company
operands.source: the company, under the identifier `account_discount_income_allocation_id`, whose full name is the separate account for income discount
operands.constraints: used on a purchase document

operands.name: document direction
operands.constraints: sale or purchase

preconditions.condition: The account relevant to the document's direction is set on the company.
preconditions.otherwise: No discount allocation line is produced at all.

preconditions.condition: The product line's own account differs from the discount allocation account.
preconditions.otherwise: The line contributes nothing, since moving the amount would leave it where it already is.

procedure: Read the document's direction.
For a sale document, take the company's separate account for expense discount.
For a purchase document, take the company's separate account for income discount.
Stop entirely when the relevant account is not set.
records.formula: discount allocation account = the company's separate account for expense discount on a sale document, the company's separate account for income discount on a purchase document ; no line is produced when that account is not set

rounding.what: Nothing; the result is an account.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: the discount allocation account
result.stored_or_displayed: Used as part of the key of the discount allocation entries and as the account of the produced allocation line.

edge_cases.case: The company has not configured the account for the document's direction.
edge_cases.outcome: No discount allocation line is produced and the discount stays inside the revenue amount of the product line.

edge_cases.case: A product line's own account is already the discount allocation account.
edge_cases.outcome: That line contributes no entry.

edge_cases.case: A product line carries no discount.
edge_cases.outcome: The discounted amount rounds to zero and the line contributes nothing.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice in a company that has configured the separate account for expense discount as an account named Discounts Granted.
worked_examples.narrative: The document is a sale, so the separate account for expense discount is taken; it differs from the product line's own account, so the line contributes a reversal entry on Product Sales and an allocation entry on Discounts Granted.

records.name: The discounted amount of a product line
records.purpose: Measures the part of a product line that the line discount takes away, in both currencies, which is the amount the discount allocation entries move between the two accounts.

operands.name: quantity of the product line
operands.unit_or_currency: the unit of measure of the line
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: unit price of the product line
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: discount of the product line
operands.constraints: zero produces no entry

operands.name: direction sign
operands.constraints: minus one on a customer invoice

operands.name: currency rate of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: units of the line currency for one unit of the company currency
operands.constraints: strictly positive

preconditions.condition: A discount allocation account is configured for the document's direction.
preconditions.otherwise: No discount allocation entry is produced.

preconditions.condition: The discounted amount does not round to zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The line contributes nothing.

procedure: Multiply the direction sign, the quantity, the unit price and the discount, and divide by one hundred.
Round the product to the line currency to obtain the discounted amount in currency.
Divide the discounted amount in currency by the currency rate of the line and round to the company currency to obtain the discounted balance.
Stop when the discounted amount rounds to zero.
records.formula: discounted_amount_currency = round( direction_sign × quantity × price_unit × discount ÷ 100 , line_currency )   and   discounted_balance = round( discounted_amount_currency ÷ currency_rate , company_currency )

rounding.what: The discounted amount in the line currency, and then the discounted balance in the company currency.
rounding.precision: The line currency and the company currency.
rounding.step: The amount in currency is rounded first, and the balance is derived from the already-rounded amount, not from the raw product.

result.name: the discounted amount of the line
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored directly; it becomes the amount of the two discount allocation entries the line contributes.

edge_cases.case: The discount is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The discounted amount is zero, the line contributes nothing and no entry is produced.

edge_cases.case: The discounted amount rounds to zero although the discount is not zero, for example a discount of one per cent on a line of 0.20.
edge_cases.outcome: The line contributes nothing.

edge_cases.case: The line currency equals the company currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The rate is one and the two amounts are equal.

edge_cases.case: The quantity or the unit price is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The discounted amount takes the opposite sign and the two entries swap sides.

worked_examples.description: Ten units at one hundred with a discount of ten per cent on a customer invoice, in the company currency.
worked_examples.narrative: Minus one times ten times one hundred times ten divided by one hundred is minus 100.00, the same in both currencies at a rate of one.

worked_examples.description: Five units at two hundred with a discount of twenty per cent on the same invoice.
worked_examples.narrative: Minus one times five times two hundred times twenty divided by one hundred is minus 200.00.

records.name: The two discount allocation entries a product line contributes
records.purpose: Moves the discounted part out of the revenue account and into the discount allocation account with two journal items that cancel in the net total, so that gross revenue and discounts granted can be read separately.

operands.name: discounted amount in currency of the line
operands.constraints: not zero

operands.name: discounted balance of the line
operands.constraints: not zero

operands.name: account of the product line
operands.constraints: part of the key of the reversal entry

operands.name: discount allocation account
operands.constraints: part of the key of the allocation entry

operands.name: currency rate
operands.unit_or_currency: units of the line currency for one unit of the company currency
operands.constraints: part of both keys

preconditions.condition: The discounted amount does not round to zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The line contributes nothing.

preconditions.condition: The product line's account differs from the discount allocation account.
preconditions.otherwise: No entry is produced for that line.

procedure: Produce a reversal entry keyed by the product line's own account, the document and the currency rate, carrying the discounted amount and the discounted balance with a positive sign.
Produce an allocation entry keyed by the discount allocation account, the document and the currency rate, carrying the discounted amount and the discounted balance with a negative sign.
Label both entries “Discount” and give both the display type `discount`.
Hand both entries to the aggregation, which adds the contributions of every product line that shares a key.
records.formula: reversal entry on the product line's account : amount_in_currency = + discounted_amount_currency , balance = + discounted_balance ; allocation entry on the discount allocation account : amount_in_currency = − discounted_amount_currency , balance = − discounted_balance

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the two amounts were rounded when the discounted amount was computed.
rounding.precision: The line currency and the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the pair of discount allocation entries
result.unit_or_currency: the line currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as journal items with display type `discount`, labelled “Discount”; the document totals ignore them, because they always come in pairs that cancel.

edge_cases.case: Two product lines share the same revenue account, the same document and the same rate.
edge_cases.outcome: Their reversal entries share a key and are added into one journal item, and likewise their allocation entries.

edge_cases.case: The two entries are added together.
edge_cases.outcome: They cancel, so the net total of the document is unchanged, which is why the totals walk ignores lines of display type `discount`.

edge_cases.case: The discounted amount is negative because the direction sign is minus one on a customer invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: The reversal entry is a debit on the revenue account and the allocation entry is a credit on the discount account, which reduces revenue and shows the discount in its own account.

worked_examples.description: Two product lines of a customer invoice, both on the account Product Sales, contributing minus 100.00 and minus 200.00, with the discount allocation account named Discounts Granted.
worked_examples.narrative: Both lines share the key of the reversal entry and the key of the allocation entry, so the aggregation adds them into one pair: a debit of 300.00 on Product Sales, which reduces the credited revenue, and a credit of 300.00 on Discounts Granted, where the discount is now visible on its own.

records.name: The analytic distribution of the discount allocation lines as a weighted merge
records.purpose: Gives each produced discount allocation line an analytic distribution that reflects how much of the discount belongs to each analytic account, when several product lines with different distributions contribute to one line.

operands.name: balance of each contributed entry
operands.source: the two entries each product line contributes
operands.constraints: used as the weight

operands.name: percentage of each analytic account in the product line's distribution
operands.source: the analytic distribution of the product line
operands.constraints: the percentages of one line add up to one hundred

operands.name: key of the produced line
operands.source: the account, the document and the currency rate
operands.constraints: the weights are accumulated per key

preconditions.condition: At least one contributing product line carries an analytic distribution.
preconditions.otherwise: The produced line carries no analytic distribution.

preconditions.condition: The sum of the weighted amounts of a key is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The denominator is replaced by one, so the percentages are computed against one rather than against zero.

procedure: For every product line, for each of its two entries, and for every analytic account in that product line's distribution, multiply the entry's balance by the percentage of that analytic account and divide by one hundred.
Accumulate that weighted amount under the key of the entry and the analytic account, over all product lines sharing the key.
For each key, divide each accumulated weighted amount by the sum of the weighted amounts of that key, multiply by one hundred, and replace the denominator by one when it would be zero.
Store the resulting percentage map on the produced line; it adds up to one hundred up to the storage precision.
records.formula: weighted_amount( key , analytic_account ) += entry_balance × q ÷ 100 , accumulated over the product lines sharing the key ; distribution( analytic_account ) = 100 × weighted_amount( key , analytic_account ) ÷ Σ weighted_amount( key , all analytic accounts ), the denominator replaced by one when it would be zero

rounding.what: The percentages of the resulting map.
rounding.precision: The storage precision of an analytic percentage.
rounding.step: After the division by the sum of the weighted amounts and the multiplication by one hundred, once per analytic account.

result.name: the analytic distribution of the produced line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the journal item of display type `discount`.

edge_cases.case: Every contributing line names the same single analytic account.
edge_cases.outcome: That account takes one hundred per cent.

edge_cases.case: The sum of the weighted amounts is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The denominator is replaced by one and the percentages are the weighted amounts multiplied by one hundred.

edge_cases.case: The percentages do not divide evenly.
edge_cases.outcome: They add up to one hundred only up to the storage precision, as with two thirds and one third giving 66.67 and 33.33.

worked_examples.description: Two product lines contributing minus 100.00 and minus 200.00 to one key, the first entirely on Project Alpha and the second split evenly between Project Alpha and Project Beta.

inputs.first line distribution: Project Alpha one hundred per cent
inputs.second line distribution: Project Alpha fifty per cent and Project Beta fifty per cent

worked_examples.narrative: Project Alpha collects minus 100.00 from the first line and minus 100.00 from the second, that is minus 200.00, and Project Beta collects minus 100.00; over a total of minus 300.00 that gives 200 divided by 300, which is 66.666 and more per cent, stored as 66.67, and 100 divided by 300, which is 33.333 and more per cent, stored as 33.33.

records.name: Worked example of the discount allocation lines on a two-line invoice
records.purpose: Carries the discount allocation from two product lines with different analytic distributions to the two produced journal items, so that a rebuild can check the amounts, the accounts and the analytic percentages against a known result.

operands.name: first product line
operands.constraints: ten units at one hundred with a discount of ten per cent, entirely on Project Alpha

operands.name: second product line
operands.constraints: five units at two hundred with a discount of twenty per cent, split evenly between Project Alpha and Project Beta

operands.name: income account of both lines
operands.constraints: an account named Product Sales

operands.name: discount allocation account
operands.constraints: an account named Discounts Granted

preconditions.condition: The company has configured the separate account for expense discount.
preconditions.otherwise: No discount allocation line is produced.

preconditions.condition: The direction sign is minus one and the rate is one.
preconditions.otherwise: The signs and the two currency columns change.

procedure: Compute the discounted amount of the first line as minus one times ten times one hundred times ten divided by one hundred.
Compute the discounted amount of the second line as minus one times five times two hundred times twenty divided by one hundred.
Note that both lines share the key of the reversal entry and the key of the allocation entry, so the aggregation adds their contributions.
Compute the analytic weights and turn them into percentages.
Produce the two journal items.
records.formula: A: discounted = round( −1 × 10 × 100.00 × 10 ÷ 100 ) = −100.00 ; B: discounted = round( −1 × 5 × 200.00 × 20 ÷ 100 ) = −200.00 ; aggregated = −300.00 ; Project Alpha = 200 ÷ 300 = 66.67 per cent ; Project Beta = 100 ÷ 300 = 33.33 per cent

rounding.what: Each discounted amount and each analytic percentage.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places for the amounts, the storage precision of an analytic percentage for the percentages.
rounding.step: The discounted amounts when each line contributes, the percentages after the weighted amounts have been accumulated.

result.name: the two produced discount allocation lines
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency, which is also the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as two journal items with display type `discount`, labelled “Discount”.

edge_cases.case: The two produced lines are added together.
edge_cases.outcome: They cancel, so the totals of the document do not change.

edge_cases.case: The effect on the two accounts is read.
edge_cases.outcome: Revenue is reduced by a debit of 300.00 on Product Sales and the discount appears as a credit of 300.00 on Discounts Granted.

worked_examples.description: The two product lines and the two produced journal items.

inputs.first line analytic distribution: Project Alpha one hundred per cent
inputs.second line analytic distribution: Project Alpha fifty per cent and Project Beta fifty per cent

expected_outputs.analytic distribution of both produced l: Project Alpha 66.67 per cent and Project Beta 33.33 per cent

worked_examples.narrative: The two lines discount 100.00 and 200.00, which the aggregation adds to 300.00 on each of the two shared keys; the reversal line debits Product Sales by 300.00 and the allocation line credits Discounts Granted by 300.00, and both carry the weighted analytic distribution of 66.67 per cent to Project Alpha and 33.33 per cent to Project Beta.

records.name: Rounding an amount to a multiple of the coin, method up
records.purpose: Moves an amount away from zero to the next multiple of the smallest coin, which is one of the three ways a document total can be made payable in cash.

operands.name: amount to round
operands.source: the amount being cash rounded, already rounded to the currency
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: rounding precision
operands.source: the rounding precision of the cash rounding method, that is the smallest coin
operands.constraints: strictly positive; a non-positive value is refused with the message “Please set a strictly positive rounding value.”

preconditions.condition: The rounding precision is strictly positive.
preconditions.otherwise: The cash rounding method is refused with the message “Please set a strictly positive rounding value.”

procedure: Divide the amount by the rounding precision to obtain the quotient.
Take the absolute value of the quotient and round it upwards to the next whole number.
Restore the sign of the amount.
Multiply by the rounding precision.
records.formula: result = r × ( sign( a ) × ceiling( | a ÷ r | ) ), where a is the amount and r the rounding precision

rounding.what: The magnitude of the amount.
rounding.precision: The rounding precision of the cash rounding method.
rounding.method: Always away from zero, to the next multiple of the coin.
rounding.step: After the amount has first been rounded to the currency, so that sub-unit noise cannot push it over a coin boundary.

result.name: the coin multiple
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the cash rounding difference, which is what is stored on the rounding line.

edge_cases.case: The amount is already a multiple of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is the amount itself and the difference is zero.

edge_cases.case: The amount is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The magnitude is rounded away from zero, so minus 23.91 becomes minus 23.95 at a coin of five hundredths.

edge_cases.case: The amount is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero.

worked_examples.description: Amounts at a coin of five hundredths on a two-decimal currency.
worked_examples.narrative: Each magnitude is carried up to the next multiple of five hundredths and the sign is restored, so the differences are positive for positive amounts and negative for negative ones.

records.name: Rounding an amount to a multiple of the coin, method down
records.purpose: Moves an amount towards zero to the previous multiple of the smallest coin, which is one of the three ways a document total can be made payable in cash.

operands.name: amount to round
operands.source: the amount being cash rounded, already rounded to the currency
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: rounding precision
operands.source: the rounding precision of the cash rounding method
operands.constraints: strictly positive

preconditions.condition: The rounding precision is strictly positive.
preconditions.otherwise: The cash rounding method is refused with the message “Please set a strictly positive rounding value.”

procedure: Divide the amount by the rounding precision to obtain the quotient.
Take the absolute value of the quotient and take its whole part downwards.
Restore the sign of the amount.
Multiply by the rounding precision.
records.formula: result = r × ( sign( a ) × floor( | a ÷ r | ) ), where a is the amount and r the rounding precision

rounding.what: The magnitude of the amount.
rounding.precision: The rounding precision of the cash rounding method.
rounding.method: Always towards zero, to the multiple of the coin nearest zero whose magnitude does not exceed the amount's.
rounding.step: After the amount has first been rounded to the currency.

result.name: the coin multiple
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the cash rounding difference.

edge_cases.case: The amount is already a multiple of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is the amount itself and the difference is zero.

edge_cases.case: The amount is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The magnitude is reduced, so minus 23.91 becomes minus 23.90 and the difference is positive.

edge_cases.case: The magnitude of the amount is smaller than the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero.

worked_examples.description: Amounts at a coin of five hundredths on a two-decimal currency.
worked_examples.narrative: Each magnitude falls to the previous multiple of five hundredths and the sign is restored, so a positive amount gives a negative difference and a negative amount a positive one.

records.name: Rounding an amount to a multiple of the coin, method nearest
records.purpose: Moves an amount to the closest multiple of the smallest coin, resolving a tie away from zero, which is the ordinary way a document total is made payable in cash.

operands.name: amount to round
operands.source: the amount being cash rounded, already rounded to the currency
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: rounding precision
operands.source: the rounding precision of the cash rounding method
operands.constraints: strictly positive

preconditions.condition: The rounding precision is strictly positive.
preconditions.otherwise: The cash rounding method is refused with the message “Please set a strictly positive rounding value.”

procedure: Divide the amount by the rounding precision to obtain the quotient.
Take the absolute value of the quotient, add one half and take the whole part downwards.
Restore the sign of the amount.
Multiply by the rounding precision.
records.formula: result = r × ( sign( a ) × floor( | a ÷ r | + 0.5 ) ), where a is the amount and r the rounding precision

rounding.what: The magnitude of the amount.
rounding.precision: The rounding precision of the cash rounding method.
rounding.method: To the nearest multiple of the coin, a tie being resolved away from zero.
rounding.step: After the amount has first been rounded to the currency, which removes sub-unit noise before the coin rounding.

result.name: the coin multiple
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the cash rounding difference.

edge_cases.case: The amount is exactly halfway between two multiples of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The tie is resolved away from zero.

edge_cases.case: The amount is already a multiple of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is the amount itself and the difference is zero.

edge_cases.case: The amount carries a third decimal, for example 23.925.
edge_cases.outcome: It is first rounded to the currency, giving 23.93, and only then to the coin, giving 23.95.

worked_examples.description: Amounts at a coin of five hundredths on a two-decimal currency.
worked_examples.narrative: 23.91 is closer to 23.90 and 23.93 is closer to 23.95; 23.925 is first rounded to the currency as 23.93 and then to the coin as 23.95, which is why the currency rounding comes first.

records.name: The cash rounding difference
records.purpose: Gives the amount added to a figure to make it a multiple of the smallest coin, which is the amount carried by the rounding line and by every instalment correction.

operands.name: amount
operands.unit_or_currency: the currency it is expressed in
operands.source: a document total, an instalment or a discounted amount
operands.constraints: may carry more decimals than the currency

operands.name: currency
operands.constraints: the amount is rounded to it first

operands.name: rounding precision and method of the cash rounding method
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and a stored selection value
operands.source: the cash rounding method of the document
operands.constraints: the precision is strictly positive

preconditions.condition: A cash rounding method with a strictly positive precision is available.
preconditions.otherwise: No difference can be computed and no cash rounding is applied.

procedure: Round the amount to the currency, which removes sub-unit noise before the coin rounding.
Round that value to the coin multiple by the method of the cash rounding method.
Subtract the value rounded to the currency from the coin multiple.
Round the subtraction to the currency.
records.formula: a' = round( a , C ) ; difference = round( round_to_coin( a' ) − a' , C )

rounding.what: The amount, then the coin multiple, then the difference.
rounding.precision: The currency for the first and the third, the coin of the cash rounding method for the second.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency, the method of the cash rounding method for the coin.
rounding.step: The currency rounding first, because rounding to the currency before the coin rounding is what keeps a third decimal from shifting the result across a coin boundary.

result.name: cash rounding difference
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the rounding line of the document, or added to an instalment or to a discounted amount.

edge_cases.case: The amount is already a multiple of the coin.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference is zero and the routine that asked for it does nothing.

edge_cases.case: The amount carries a third decimal.
edge_cases.outcome: It is rounded to the currency first, so 23.925 becomes 23.93 and only then moves to 23.95.

edge_cases.case: The amount is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference takes the sign the method dictates, so at the nearest method minus 23.91 gives a difference of plus 0.01.

worked_examples.description: A customer-facing gross total of 121.23 at a coin of five hundredths, nearest method.
worked_examples.narrative: The nearest multiple of five hundredths to 121.23 is 121.25, so the customer-facing difference is plus 0.02.

worked_examples.description: The same total in accounting sign, that is minus 121.23.
worked_examples.narrative: In accounting signs the sum of the non-receivable lines is minus 121.23, the coin multiple is minus 121.25 and the difference is minus 0.02, that is a credit of 0.02 on the rounding line.

records.name: The recomputation of the cash rounding line
records.purpose: Keeps at most one rounding line on a draft invoice, in agreement with the document's cash rounding method and with the current totals, creating it, updating it or deleting it as the document changes.

operands.name: existing rounding line
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the line of the document whose display type is `rounding`
operands.constraints: at most one per document

operands.name: cash rounding method of the document
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: strategy of the cash rounding method
operands.unit_or_currency: not applicable, a stored selection value
operands.constraints: either `add_invoice_line`, labelled Add a rounding line, or `biggest_tax`, labelled Modify the biggest tax amount

operands.name: strategy of the existing line
operands.source: deduced from the line itself: the biggest-tax strategy when the line carries an originator tax, the add-a-line strategy otherwise
operands.constraints: compared with the current strategy

preconditions.condition: The document is a draft invoice.
preconditions.otherwise: The routine does not run; it runs at sequence thirty of the synchronisation stack on draft invoices only.

procedure: Find the existing cash rounding line, that is the line whose display type is `rounding`.
When the document has no cash rounding method, delete the existing line if there is one and stop.

When the strategy has changed since the line was produced, deduced as the biggest-tax strategy when the line carries an originator tax and the add-a-line strategy otherwise, delete the existing line and treat the family as empty.
Compute the amount to round and the difference.
When the difference is zero in the document currency, tested on both the balance and the amount in currency at the document currency's precision, delete the existing line and stop.
When the existing line already carries exactly this difference in both currencies, compared at the document currency's precision, stop.
Otherwise build the values of the rounding line and apply the strategy.
Write the values onto the existing line, or create the line when there is none.
records.formula: no method → delete the line ; strategy changed → delete the line and start afresh ; difference is zero → delete the line ; existing line already carries the difference → stop ; otherwise → create or update one line with that difference

rounding.what: The difference, and the comparisons against the existing line.
rounding.precision: The document currency, for both the balance and the amount in currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency rounding, the method of the cash rounding method for the coin rounding.
rounding.step: The difference is computed before the comparisons, and the comparisons are made at the document currency's precision even for the balance.

result.name: the cash rounding line of the document
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as at most one journal item with display type `rounding`.

edge_cases.case: The cash rounding method is removed from the document.
edge_cases.outcome: The rounding line is deleted.

edge_cases.case: The strategy is changed from one to the other.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing line is deleted and a fresh one is built, because the two strategies produce lines of different kinds.

edge_cases.case: The biggest-tax strategy is chosen and the document carries no tax line at all.
edge_cases.outcome: No rounding line is produced and the document total is left unrounded; the strategy silently does nothing rather than falling back to the other strategy.

edge_cases.case: The add-a-line strategy is chosen and no profit account is configured for the company.
edge_cases.outcome: A non-blocking warning is shown, headed with the name of the cash rounding method, saying that the profit account must be specified.

worked_examples.description: A draft invoice whose non-receivable lines sum to minus 121.23, with a method of five hundredths and the nearest rounding, under the add-a-line strategy.
worked_examples.narrative: There is no existing line, the difference is not zero, so one rounding line is created carrying a credit of 0.02.

worked_examples.description: The same invoice written again with no change.
worked_examples.narrative: The existing line already carries exactly this difference in both currencies, so the routine stops.

records.name: The amount to round and the difference of the cash rounding line
records.purpose: Computes the figure the rounding line has to carry, from the accounting-signed sum of every line that is neither receivable nor payable, and converts it to the company currency.

operands.name: amounts in currency of the lines that are neither receivable nor payable
operands.source: every line of the document except the receivable or payable lines and the rounding line itself
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: document currency and company currency
operands.constraints: the conversion applies only when they differ

operands.name: document date, else accounting date
operands.constraints: the date at which the currency rate table is read for the conversion

preconditions.condition: The document carries a cash rounding method.
preconditions.otherwise: No difference is computed and the rounding line is deleted.

procedure: Take every line whose account is neither of the receivable nor of the payable kind, excluding the rounding line itself.
Sum their amounts in currency to obtain the amount to round, which is accounting-signed and therefore the negation of the customer-facing gross total on a customer invoice.
Compute the cash rounding difference of that sum in the document currency.
Take the same figure as the balance when the document currency equals the company currency.

Otherwise convert the difference from the document currency to the company currency, for the company, at the document date or, absent one, the accounting date, using the currency rate table and not the document's stored rate.
records.formula: T = Σ over the lines that are neither receivable nor payable of ( amount in currency ) ; diff_amount_currency = cash_rounding_difference( document_currency , T ) ; diff_balance = diff_amount_currency when the two currencies are equal, otherwise convert( diff_amount_currency , document currency → company currency , company , document date or accounting date )

rounding.what: The difference in the document currency, and its converted counterpart in the company currency.
rounding.precision: The document currency, then the company currency.
rounding.method: The method of the cash rounding method for the coin, half away from zero for each currency rounding.
rounding.step: The sum is taken first, then the coin rounding, then the conversion.

result.name: the two amounts of the rounding line
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as the amount in currency and the balance of the journal item with display type `rounding`.

edge_cases.case: The document currency equals the company currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance is the difference itself and no conversion is performed.

edge_cases.case: The document currency differs from the company currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance is converted at the currency rate table for the document date, not at the document's stored rate, which is the one exception to the rate rule of the domain.

edge_cases.case: The difference is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The existing rounding line is deleted and no new one is created.

edge_cases.case: The sum is taken in accounting signs.
edge_cases.outcome: On a customer invoice the amount to round is the negation of the customer-facing gross total, so a customer-facing difference of plus 0.02 appears as minus 0.02 on the line.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice whose three product lines and two tax lines sum to minus 121.23 in accounting signs, with a coin of five hundredths and the nearest method, in one currency.
worked_examples.narrative: The accounting-signed sum is minus 121.23, whose nearest multiple of five hundredths is minus 121.25, so the difference is minus 0.02 and the rounding line is a credit of 0.02; the customer-facing gross total moves from 121.23 to 121.25.

records.name: The values of the cash rounding line under the strategy that adds a rounding line
records.purpose: Builds the rounding line as an ordinary base line on a profit or loss account, which moves the net total of the document by the rounding difference and leaves the tax total alone.

operands.name: balance of the rounding line
operands.constraints: its sign decides which account is used

operands.name: amount in currency of the rounding line
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: loss account of the cash rounding method
operands.source: the cash rounding method, read in the document's company because it is company-dependent
operands.constraints: used when the balance is strictly positive and the account is set

operands.name: profit account of the cash rounding method
operands.source: the cash rounding method, read in the document's company
operands.constraints: used otherwise

operands.name: name of the cash rounding method
operands.constraints: becomes the label of the line

preconditions.condition: The strategy of the cash rounding method is `add_invoice_line`, labelled Add a rounding line.
preconditions.otherwise: The biggest-tax branch applies.

preconditions.condition: The account that the sign selects is configured for the company.
preconditions.otherwise: A non-blocking warning is shown saying that the profit account must be specified.

procedure: Set the label of the line to the name of the cash rounding method.

Choose the account: the loss account when the balance is strictly positive and that account is set, and the profit account otherwise; both are read in the document's company because they are company-dependent.
Clear the taxes of the line.
Set the partner to the commercial entity, the document, the document currency, the company, the company currency and the display type `rounding`.

rounding.what: Nothing further; the two amounts were rounded when the difference was computed.
rounding.precision: The document currency and the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency, the method of the cash rounding method for the coin.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the rounding line as a base line
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as a journal item with display type `rounding` and no tax repartition, so the totals walk counts it in the net total.

edge_cases.case: The balance is strictly positive, that is a debit.
edge_cases.outcome: The loss account is used, when it is set.

edge_cases.case: The balance is negative or zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The profit account is used.

edge_cases.case: The loss account is not set although the balance is strictly positive.
edge_cases.outcome: The profit account is used.

edge_cases.case: No profit account is configured for the company.
edge_cases.outcome: A non-blocking warning is shown, headed with the name of the cash rounding method, saying that the profit account must be specified.

worked_examples.description: A rounding line of minus 0.02 on a customer invoice whose profit account is named Cash Rounding Gain.

records.name: The values of the cash rounding line under the strategy that modifies the biggest tax amount
records.purpose: Builds the rounding line as a copy of the largest tax line, which moves the tax total of the document by the rounding difference and leaves the net total alone.

operands.name: tax lines of the document
operands.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
operands.source: the lines whose display type is `tax`
operands.constraints: the one with the largest absolute balance is chosen

operands.name: balance and amount in currency of the rounding line
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
operands.constraints: none

operands.name: label of the biggest tax line
operands.constraints: the rounding line's label is that label followed by “ (rounding)”

preconditions.condition: The strategy of the cash rounding method is `biggest_tax`, labelled Modify the biggest tax amount.
preconditions.otherwise: The add-a-line branch applies.

preconditions.condition: The document carries at least one tax line.
preconditions.otherwise: No rounding line is produced and the document total is left unrounded; the strategy silently does nothing rather than falling back to the other strategy.

procedure: Find the tax line with the largest absolute balance; stop when there is none.
Set the label to that tax line's label followed by the words in brackets that mark it as a rounding line.
Copy that tax line's account.
Copy that tax line's tax repartition line.
Copy that tax line's tax grids.
Copy that tax line's taxes.
Write the balance and the amount in currency computed by the difference, with the display type `rounding`.
records.formula: biggest tax line = the tax line maximising | balance | ; account, tax repartition line, tax grids and taxes = those of the biggest tax line ; label = the biggest tax line's label followed by “ (rounding)”

rounding.what: Nothing further; the two amounts were rounded when the difference was computed.
rounding.precision: The document currency and the company currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency, the method of the cash rounding method for the coin.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the rounding line as a tax line
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency and the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as a journal item with display type `rounding` that carries a tax repartition, so the totals walk counts it in the tax total.

edge_cases.case: The document carries no tax line.

worked_examples.description: An invoice with a tax line of 17.36 at twenty-one per cent and a tax line of 1.20 at six per cent, and a rounding difference of minus 0.02.

procedure: Note that a rounding line produced by the add-a-line strategy is itself a base line for the tax engine, passed with quantity one, an already tax-excluded amount and the special kind that marks it as cash rounding.
Note that a rounding line produced by the biggest-tax strategy carries a tax repartition and is therefore a tax line, not a base line.
Conclude that under the add-a-line strategy the net total changes by the difference and the tax total does not.
Conclude that under the biggest-tax strategy the tax total changes by the difference and the net total does not.
In both cases the gross total changes by the difference.

records.name: Worked example of cash rounding under the strategy that adds a rounding line
records.purpose: Carries a three-line invoice with two taxes through the add-a-line strategy from the raw amounts to the complete entry, so that a rebuild can check every figure of the rounded document.

operands.name: first product line
operands.constraints: three units at 12.34 taxed at twenty-one per cent

operands.name: second product line
operands.constraints: one unit at 45.67 taxed at twenty-one per cent

operands.name: third product line
operands.constraints: two units at 9.99 taxed at six per cent

operands.name: cash rounding method
operands.constraints: a coin of five hundredths with the nearest method

preconditions.condition: The company has configured a profit account for the cash rounding method.
preconditions.otherwise: A non-blocking warning is shown.

preconditions.condition: The document currency equals the company currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The balance of the rounding line is converted from the currency rate table.

procedure: Compute the net amount of each line: 37.02, 45.67 and 19.98, giving a net total of 102.67.
Compute the tax at twenty-one per cent on a base of 82.69, giving 17.36, and the tax at six per cent on a base of 19.98, giving 1.20, so a tax total of 18.56 and a gross total of 121.23.
Compute the accounting-signed sum of the non-receivable lines, minus 121.23, and its nearest multiple of five hundredths, minus 121.25, so a difference of minus 0.02.
Choose the profit account, because the balance is not strictly positive.
Produce the rounding line as a credit of 0.02 on the profit account with no taxes.
Produce the receivable line of 121.25.
records.formula: net total = 37.02 + 45.67 + 19.98 = 102.67 ; tax at 21 per cent = round( 82.69 × 0.21 ) = round( 17.3649 ) = 17.36 ; tax at 6 per cent = round( 19.98 × 0.06 ) = round( 1.1988 ) = 1.20 ; gross total = 121.23 ; nearest multiple of 0.05 = 121.25 ; difference = +0.02 customer-facing, −0.02 in accounting sign

rounding.what: Each per-line net amount, each tax amount and the coin rounding of the gross total.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places for the currency, five hundredths for the coin.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the currency, nearest for the coin.
rounding.step: The line amounts and the taxes first, the coin rounding of the accounting-signed sum last.

result.name: the rounded invoice and its entry
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency, which is also the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Seven journal items on the document, and a totals block showing a net total of 102.69, a tax total of 18.56 and a gross total of 121.25.

edge_cases.case: The net total moves although no product line changed.
edge_cases.outcome: The rounding line is a base line, so the two cents land in the net total.

edge_cases.case: The receivable line is compared with the sum of the credits.
edge_cases.outcome: 37.02 plus 45.67 plus 19.98 plus 0.02 plus 17.36 plus 1.20 is 121.25, which equals the debit of the receivable line.

worked_examples.narrative: The three product lines credit 37.02, 45.67 and 19.98, the two tax lines credit 17.36 and 1.20, the rounding line credits 0.02 on the profit account, and the receivable line debits 121.25, so the entry balances; the two cents sit in the net total, which the customer reads as 102.69.

records.name: Worked example of the same invoice rounded down and rounded up
records.purpose: Shows how the two remaining coin rounding methods change the difference, the account chosen and the totals of the same three-line invoice.

operands.name: coin
operands.constraints: five hundredths

operands.name: rounding method
operands.constraints: down in the first case, up in the second

preconditions.condition: The add-a-line strategy is in force.
preconditions.otherwise: The account selection by the sign of the balance does not apply, since the biggest-tax strategy copies a tax line's account.

procedure: Under the down method, find the multiple of five hundredths not exceeding 121.23 in magnitude, which is 121.20.
Compute the customer-facing difference of minus 0.03, that is an accounting balance of plus 0.03, a debit.
Note that the balance is now strictly positive, so the loss account is used.
Compute the resulting totals: a net total of 102.64, a tax total of 18.56 and a gross total of 121.20.
Under the up method, find the multiple of five hundredths at or above 121.23 in magnitude, which is 121.25, the same as the nearest method, so the result is identical to the first table.
records.formula: down : coin multiple = 121.20 , customer-facing difference = −0.03 , accounting balance = +0.03 , account = the loss account , net total = 102.64 , tax total = 18.56 , gross total = 121.20 ; up : coin multiple = 121.25 , identical to the nearest method

rounding.what: The gross total, to the coin.
rounding.precision: Five hundredths.
rounding.method: Down in the first case, up in the second.
rounding.step: After the currency rounding of the sum of the non-receivable lines.

result.name: the rounded totals under each method
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the totals block and stored on the rounding line.

edge_cases.case: The balance of the rounding line becomes strictly positive.
edge_cases.outcome: The loss account is used instead of the profit account.

edge_cases.case: The up method and the nearest method give the same coin multiple.
edge_cases.outcome: The two produce identical entries, as they do here at 121.25.

worked_examples.description: The three-line invoice rounded down.
worked_examples.narrative: The magnitude falls to 121.20, so the customer pays three cents less; the rounding line is a debit of 0.03 and therefore lands on the loss account, and the net total falls to 102.64.

worked_examples.description: The three-line invoice rounded up.
worked_examples.narrative: The magnitude rises to 121.25, the same multiple the nearest method gives, so the entry is identical to the one produced under the nearest method.

records.name: The totals walk over the lines of an invoice
records.purpose: Fills the eight accumulators from which every amount field of an invoice is derived, in a single pass over its lines, so that the totals always agree with the journal items.

operands.name: display type of each line
operands.unit_or_currency: not applicable, a stored selection value
operands.constraints: decides which accumulator the line feeds

operands.name: tax repartition of a line of display type `rounding`
operands.constraints: decides whether that line counts as tax or as net

operands.name: balance of each line
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: amount in currency of each line
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: residual and residual in currency of each payment term line
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
operands.constraints: what is still outstanding

preconditions.condition: The document is an invoice, receipts included.
preconditions.otherwise: The walk for a plain journal entry applies instead.

procedure: Initialise six accumulators to zero: untaxed and untaxed in currency, tax and tax in currency, residual and residual in currency, plus a running total and total in currency.

For a line of display type `tax`, `non_deductible_tax`, or `rounding` with a tax repartition, add its balance to the tax accumulator and to the running total, and its amount in currency to the tax-in-currency accumulator and to the running total in currency.

For a line of display type `product`, `rounding` without a tax repartition, `non_deductible_product` or `non_deductible_product_total`, add its balance to the untaxed accumulator and to the running total, and its amount in currency to the untaxed-in-currency accumulator and to the running total in currency.
For a line of display type `payment_term`, add its residual to the residual accumulator and its residual in currency to the residual-in-currency accumulator.
Ignore every other line, which means lines of display type `discount` and `epd`, cost-of-goods-sold lines, sections, subsections and notes.
records.formula: untaxed += balance of every base line ; tax += balance of every tax line ; total += balance of every base line and of every tax line ; residual += residual of every payment term line ; and the same three sums again on the amounts in currency

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the line amounts are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The company currency for the balances, the document currency for the amounts in currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied when each line amount was written.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the eight accumulators
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not stored as such; the assignments turn them into the amount fields of the document.

edge_cases.case: A line of display type `discount` or `epd`.
edge_cases.outcome: It is ignored, because such lines always come in pairs that cancel, so including them would be a computation with no effect.

edge_cases.case: A rounding line that carries a tax repartition.
edge_cases.outcome: It feeds the tax accumulator, so the tax total moves by the rounding difference.

edge_cases.case: A rounding line without a tax repartition.
edge_cases.outcome: It feeds the untaxed accumulator, so the net total moves by the rounding difference.

edge_cases.case: A section, a subsection or a note.
edge_cases.outcome: It is ignored and contributes nothing.

worked_examples.description: The three-line invoice with two taxes and one receivable line, unpaid.
worked_examples.narrative: The three product lines add to minus 1 841.00 in the untaxed accumulator, the two tax lines to minus 341.76 in the tax accumulator, both feed the running total to minus 2 182.76, and the single receivable line's residual of plus 2 182.76 fills the residual accumulator.

records.name: The totals walk over the lines of a plain journal entry
records.purpose: Fills the running total of a document that is not an invoice, where the notion of a net total and a tax total does not apply and only the debit side is summed.

operands.name: debit of each line
operands.source: the journal items of the entry
operands.constraints: only a line with a non-zero debit contributes

operands.name: balance of each contributing line
operands.constraints: positive, since the line is a debit

operands.name: amount in currency of each contributing line
operands.constraints: positive

preconditions.condition: The document is a plain journal entry.
preconditions.otherwise: The invoice walk applies instead.

procedure: Take only the lines whose debit is not zero.
Add each such line's balance to the running total.
Add each such line's amount in currency to the running total in currency.
Leave the untaxed, tax and residual accumulators at zero.
records.formula: total = Σ over the lines with a non-zero debit of ( balance ) ; total_in_currency = Σ over the same lines of ( amount in currency )

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the line amounts are already rounded.
rounding.precision: The company currency and the line currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied when each line amount was written.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the running total of a plain entry
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the line currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Turned into the total field of the entry by the assignments, where the plain-entry branch takes its absolute value.

edge_cases.case: Every line is a credit.
edge_cases.outcome: No line contributes and the total is zero; an entry with only credits cannot balance, so this does not arise on a balanced entry.

edge_cases.case: The entry balances.
edge_cases.outcome: The sum of the debits equals the sum of the credits, so the total is the one-sided value of the entry.

edge_cases.case: A line has both a zero debit and a zero credit.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes nothing.

worked_examples.description: A plain entry with a debit of 500.00 on one account and a credit of 500.00 on another.
worked_examples.narrative: Only the debit line contributes, so the total is 500.00, and the plain-entry branch of the assignments takes its absolute value, which is the same figure.

records.name: The customer-facing total assignments
records.purpose: Turns the accumulators into the four figures the customer reads on the document: the net total, the tax total, the gross total and the amount still due.

operands.name: untaxed accumulator in currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: tax accumulator in currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: running total in currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: residual accumulator in currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: direction sign
operands.constraints: plus one or minus one

preconditions.condition: The walk has filled the accumulators.
preconditions.otherwise: The assignments have nothing to convert.

procedure: Multiply the untaxed accumulator in currency by the direction sign to obtain the net total.
Multiply the tax accumulator in currency by the direction sign to obtain the tax total.
Multiply the running total in currency by the direction sign to obtain the gross total.
Multiply the residual accumulator in currency by the negation of the direction sign to obtain the amount still due.
records.formula: amount_untaxed = s × untaxed_in_currency ; amount_tax = s × tax_in_currency ; amount_total = s × total_in_currency ; amount_residual = −s × residual_in_currency, with s the direction sign

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the accumulators hold already-rounded amounts.
rounding.precision: The document currency.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the four customer-facing totals
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the document and displayed in its totals block and on the printed document.

edge_cases.case: The document is a customer invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: The direction sign is minus one, the accumulators are negative and all four figures come out positive.

edge_cases.case: The document is a customer credit note.
edge_cases.outcome: The direction sign is plus one, the accumulators are positive and all four figures again come out positive, because a credit note shows a positive amount to the customer.

edge_cases.case: The residual of the receivable lines is positive on a customer invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: The amount still due is the negation of the direction sign times that residual, which gives the same positive figure.

worked_examples.description: A customer invoice whose accumulators are minus 1 841.00 untaxed, minus 341.76 tax, minus 2 182.76 total and plus 2 182.76 residual.
worked_examples.narrative: Multiplying each accumulator by minus one gives the positive customer-facing figures, and the residual is multiplied by plus one, the negation of the direction sign, giving the same positive 2 182.76.

worked_examples.description: A customer credit note of the same size.
worked_examples.narrative: The accumulators carry the opposite signs and the direction sign is plus one, so the customer again reads positive figures.

records.name: The signed total assignments
records.purpose: Turns the accumulators into the figures a revenue or turnover report adds, where an invoice contributes a positive amount and a credit note a negative one.

operands.name: untaxed accumulator and untaxed accumulator in currency
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency and the document currency
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: tax accumulator
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: running total
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: residual accumulator
operands.constraints: accounting-signed

operands.name: customer-facing gross total
operands.constraints: used by the signed total in currency

operands.name: document type
operands.constraints: a plain entry takes the absolute value branch

preconditions.condition: The walk has filled the accumulators.
preconditions.otherwise: The assignments have nothing to convert.

procedure: Negate the untaxed accumulator to obtain the signed net total, and the untaxed accumulator in currency to obtain the signed net total in currency.
Negate the tax accumulator to obtain the signed tax total.
Take the absolute value of the running total when the document type is a plain entry, and its negation otherwise, to obtain the signed gross total.
Take the residual accumulator itself as the signed amount due.

Take the absolute value of the customer-facing gross total when the document type is a plain entry, and the negation of the direction sign times that total otherwise, to obtain the signed gross total in the document currency.
records.formula: amount_untaxed_signed = −untaxed ; amount_untaxed_in_currency_signed = −untaxed_in_currency ; amount_tax_signed = −tax ; amount_total_signed = | total | for a plain entry, −total otherwise ; amount_residual_signed = residual ; amount_total_in_currency_signed = | amount_total | for a plain entry, −( s × amount_total ) otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing at this step.
rounding.precision: The company currency, and the document currency for the two figures expressed in it.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the signed totals
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency, and the document currency for the signed total in currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the document and read by revenue reports and by the analysis projection.

edge_cases.case: The document is a customer invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: The accumulators are negative, so the signed figures are positive and the invoice adds to turnover.

edge_cases.case: The document is a customer credit note.
edge_cases.outcome: The accumulators are positive, so the signed figures are negative and the credit note subtracts from turnover, while the customer-facing figures stay positive.

edge_cases.case: The document is a plain journal entry.
edge_cases.outcome: The two total assignments take an absolute value instead of a negation.

worked_examples.description: The three-line customer invoice.
worked_examples.narrative: Each accumulator is negated, so a customer invoice contributes a positive figure to turnover; the signed amount due is the residual accumulator itself, plus 2 182.76.

worked_examples.description: A customer credit note of the same size.
worked_examples.narrative: The accumulators are positive, so the signed figures are negative and the credit note reduces turnover, which is exactly what a revenue report needs.

records.name: Worked check of the totals on the three-line invoice before cash rounding
records.purpose: Verifies every total assignment against a known set of accumulators, so that a rebuild can test the sign handling on a single example.

operands.name: the three product lines
operands.source: the invoice of the cash rounding example, before any rounding line is added
operands.constraints: 37.02, 45.67 and 19.98 tax-excluded

operands.name: the single receivable line
operands.constraints: unpaid, so its residual equals its amount

preconditions.condition: The invoice is unpaid.
preconditions.otherwise: The residual accumulator is smaller than the total and the amount due differs from the gross total.

procedure: Sum the amounts in currency of the three product lines to obtain the untaxed accumulator in currency.
Sum the amounts in currency of the two tax lines to obtain the tax accumulator in currency.
Sum both to obtain the running total in currency.
Take the residual in currency of the single receivable line.
Apply each assignment and check the figure against the customer-facing reading.

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; every line amount is already rounded.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied earlier.
rounding.step: Not applicable to this step.

result.name: the checked totals
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the document and displayed in its totals block.

edge_cases.case: The signed gross total is read as a contribution to turnover.
edge_cases.outcome: It is plus 121.23, so a customer invoice contributes a positive figure.

worked_examples.description: The three-line invoice before cash rounding.
worked_examples.narrative: Every assignment reproduces the customer-facing reading of the document: a net total of 102.67, a tax total of 18.56, a gross total of 121.23 and the same amount still due, with a signed gross total of plus 121.23 for turnover.

records.name: Worked example of a three-line invoice with two taxes from the lines to the totals
records.purpose: Carries one complete invoice through every step of the domain, from the per-line net amounts to the journal items and the totals block, as the reference trace a rebuild must reproduce.

operands.name: first product line
operands.constraints: twelve consulting hours at 85.00, no line discount, taxed at twenty-one per cent

operands.name: second product line
operands.constraints: forty printed manuals at 14.50 with a discount of ten per cent, taxed at twenty-one per cent

operands.name: third product line
operands.constraints: one digital subscription at 299.00, no line discount, taxed at six per cent

operands.name: payment term
operands.constraints: a single percent line of one hundred at zero days

operands.name: document date
operands.constraints: the fifteenth of March of the year 2026

preconditions.condition: The document currency equals the company currency.
preconditions.otherwise: The two currency columns diverge and each balance must be converted.

preconditions.condition: No cash rounding, no early discount and no discount allocation account are configured.
preconditions.otherwise: Extra lines appear and the totals move.

procedure: Compute each line's net amount as the quantity times the unit price times one less the discount divided by one hundred, rounded to the currency.
Group the lines by their tax repartition grouping key: the first two share every component and the third forms its own key.
Compute each tax on its base and round it.
Check the rounding delta: the per-line shares of the twenty-one per cent tax are 214.20 and 109.62, which add to exactly 323.82, so no unit is shifted, and the same holds for the six per cent tax.
Apply the payment term: a single percent line at one hundred per cent and zero days is also the last line, so the balance rule gives it the whole total, due on the document date.
Build the six journal items and check that the debits equal the credits.
Fill the totals and the totals block.

rounding.what: Each line's net amount and each tax amount.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: Per line first, then per tax, then the residual delta over the base lines, which is zero here; the receivable line takes the residual and is not rounded again.

result.name: the complete invoice
result.unit_or_currency: the document currency, which is also the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Six journal items on the document, eight total fields, and a totals block of four rows.

edge_cases.outcome: One tax line of 323.82 is produced for both, because the partner, the currency, the analytic distribution, the account and the tax set are identical.

edge_cases.case: The per-line tax shares add up exactly.
edge_cases.outcome: The delta is zero and no cent is shifted onto any line.

edge_cases.case: The residual accumulator is read for the amount due.
edge_cases.outcome: It holds the receivable line's residual of plus 2 182.76, and the customer-facing residual is its negation times the direction sign, giving the same positive figure.

operands.name: unit price of each of the two lines
operands.constraints: 21.53, tax included

operands.name: tax rate
operands.constraints: twenty-one per cent, included in the price

operands.name: rounding scope
operands.constraints: global rounding, so the totals are rounded once for the whole document

preconditions.condition: The tax is included in the price.
preconditions.otherwise: The net amount is the unit price itself and no division is needed.

preconditions.condition: The company rounds globally.
preconditions.otherwise: The per-line rounding governs and no delta is produced.

procedure: Divide the tax-included unit price by one plus the tax rate to obtain the raw net amount per line.
Round the raw net amount per line to the currency.
Sum the raw net amounts and round the sum to the currency to obtain the rounded net total.
Subtract the two rounded per-line amounts from the rounded net total to obtain the delta.
Add the delta to the first line, so that its stored balance differs from its displayed subtotal.
records.formula: raw net per line = 21.53 ÷ 1.21 = 17.79338843… ; rounded per line = 17.79 ; raw net total = 35.58677686… ; rounded net total = 35.59 ; delta = 35.59 − 17.79 − 17.79 = +0.01

rounding.what: The raw net amount per line and the raw net total.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: Per line first, then on the total, and the difference between the two results is the delta.

result.name: the stored net amounts of the two lines
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored as the balances 17.80 and 17.79, while both displayed subtotals remain 17.79.

edge_cases.case: The delta is added to the first line.
edge_cases.outcome: That line's stored balance is 17.80 while its displayed subtotal stays 17.79, so the two differ by one hundredth.

edge_cases.case: The two rounded per-line amounts already add up to the rounded total.
edge_cases.outcome: The delta is zero and no unit is shifted, as in the three-line invoice with two taxes.

worked_examples.description: Two lines at a tax-included unit price of 21.53 with a tax of twenty-one per cent.
worked_examples.narrative: Each line's raw net amount is 17.79338843 and more, rounding to 17.79, but the raw total of 35.58677686 and more rounds to 35.59, so a delta of one hundredth is added to the first line.

records.name: Worked example of the rounding delta on the tax amounts of two price-included lines
records.purpose: Shows the same shift applied to the tax details, where the delta is negative and the single tax line still carries the rounded total of the tax.

operands.name: unit price of each of the two lines
operands.constraints: 21.53, tax included

operands.name: tax rate
operands.constraints: twenty-one per cent, included in the price

preconditions.condition: The two lines share a tax repartition grouping key.
preconditions.otherwise: Two tax lines are produced and no delta arises between them.

procedure: Compute the raw tax per line as the tax-included unit price divided by one plus the tax rate, multiplied by the tax rate.
Round the raw tax per line to the currency.
Sum the raw taxes and round the sum to obtain the rounded tax total.
Subtract the two rounded per-line taxes from the rounded tax total to obtain the delta.
Apply the delta so that one line's tax detail becomes 3.73 while the other stays 3.74, and let the single tax line carry 7.47.
records.formula: raw tax per line = 21.53 ÷ 1.21 × 0.21 = 3.73661157… ; rounded per line = 3.74 ; raw tax total = 7.473223141… ; rounded tax total = 7.47 ; delta = 7.47 − 3.74 − 3.74 = −0.01

rounding.what: The raw tax per line and the raw tax total.
rounding.precision: Two decimal places.
rounding.step: Per tax first, then per base line, then the residual difference is distributed over the base lines.

result.name: the tax details of the two lines and the single tax line
result.stored_or_displayed: One tax line of 7.47 on the document; the per-line tax details are 3.73 and 3.74.

edge_cases.case: The delta is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: One line's tax detail is reduced by one hundredth rather than increased.

edge_cases.case: The final figures are checked.
edge_cases.outcome: The net total is 17.80 plus 17.79, that is 35.59, the tax is 7.47 and the gross total is 21.53 plus 21.53, that is 43.06; the check that 35.59 times 0.21 is 7.4739, close to 7.47, holds.

worked_examples.description: The tax details of the same two lines.
worked_examples.narrative: Each raw tax is 3.73661157 and more, rounding to 3.74, but the raw total of 7.473223141 and more rounds to 7.47, so one hundredth is taken back from one line; the single tax line carries 7.47 and the document totals are a net of 35.59, a tax of 7.47 and a gross of 43.06.

records.name: Deciding when a document takes its number
records.purpose: Fixes the moment a document stops showing a placeholder and takes a real number from the sequence, and the order in which a batch of documents is numbered so that consecutive numbers follow the accounting dates.

operands.name: posted-before flag, status, journal, accounting date, document type and originating payment
operands.constraints: a change to any of them recomputes the number

operands.name: accounting date
operands.constraints: a document with none takes no number

operands.name: current number
operands.constraints: the placeholder `/` counts as no number

operands.name: sort keys of the batch
operands.constraints: accounting date, then reference, then internal identifier

preconditions.condition: One of the six watched fields changed.
preconditions.otherwise: The number is not recomputed.

preconditions.condition: The document status is not cancelled.
preconditions.otherwise: The number is left alone.

procedure: Sort the documents of the batch by accounting date, then by reference, then by internal identifier, so that documents created in one operation receive consecutive numbers in date order.
For each document, leave the number alone when the status is cancelled.
Clear the number and stop when the document has never been posted and its current number does not match the period of its accounting date, which is what makes a draft's number follow its date.
Take the next number of the sequence when the document has an accounting date, has no number or carries the placeholder `/`, and its status is not draft.
Leave a draft without a number, showing instead the placeholder that says which number it would take.
records.formula: cancelled → keep the number ; never posted and the number does not match the accounting date's period → clear the number ; has an accounting date and no number or the placeholder and the status is not draft → take the next number of the sequence ; otherwise → no number

rounding.what: Nothing; the result is an identifier.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: the number of the document
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the document; a draft displays the placeholder number it would take.

edge_cases.case: The document is cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: Its number is left as it stands, so a cancelled document keeps the number it consumed.

edge_cases.case: A draft is redated into another month while its number was built for the old month.
edge_cases.outcome: The number is cleared, because the document has never been posted and its number no longer matches the period of its accounting date.

edge_cases.case: A batch of documents is created in one operation.
edge_cases.outcome: They are numbered in the order accounting date, reference, internal identifier, so their numbers follow their dates.

edge_cases.case: The document carries the placeholder `/`.
edge_cases.outcome: It counts as having no number and the next number of the sequence is taken.
